stages.text: When Damage Control comes for Kamran at the mosque, Rasheed and Sheikh Abdullah stall the agents. Rasheed offers them his famous cookies while Abdullah stands firm.
stages.whoA: The imam he helps stall the agents
stages.whoB: A friend who stalls the agents with him

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby and Muneeba trade gossip about Fatima's broken engagement as Muneeba shops for the wedding. Muneeba names Ruby as one of the people who made her feel at home, and Ruby celebrates Aamir's wedding with the family.
stages.whoA: Her friend, Kamala's mother
stages.whoB: Her gossiping friend

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby tells Kamala her dress is wrong and gossips that Aisha killed a man. At Aamir's wedding she dances with Kamala, and later shields Ms. Marvel from Damage Control.
stages.whoA: Muneeba's daughter, the hero she shields
stages.whoB: A family friend

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Ruby joins the crowd around Ms. Marvel outside Coles Academic. She plants herself in front of Barrie and tells him the hero saved their lives.
stages.whoA: The agent she stands up to
stages.whoB: A bystander who blocks him

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem lashes at Kamala with his whip at Aamir's wedding and corners her before Damage Control arrives. He chases her through Karachi until he is killed.
stages.whoA: The girl with the bangle he hunts
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who fights her with a whip

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem points out that Kamran is only 17 when Kamala visits. After the breakout he helps the hurt Kamran, but leaves him behind on Najma's order with an apology.
stages.whoA: Najma's son, whom he leaves behind
stages.whoB: A Clandestine who says sorry as he leaves

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem follows Najma from the bangle hunt in 1942 to the wedding attack. When she orders them to abandon Kamran, he obeys, and dies in her attack on the Red Daggers.
stages.whoA: The Clandestines' leader
stages.whoB: One of her Clandestines

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Saleem joins the raid on the Red Daggers' hideout in Karachi. Waleed kills him with two daggers to the chest.
stages.whoA: The Red Dagger who kills him
stages.whoB: A Clandestine he kills

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Zainab greets her cousin Kamala in Karachi and shows her the city with an app. She heads off for coffee with friends when Kamala wants to see the train station.
stages.whoA: Her cousin from America
stages.whoB: Her cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Zainab welcomes her aunt Muneeba to Karachi. She is there when Muneeba learns Kamala has gone missing.
stages.whoA: Kamala's mother
stages.whoB: Kamala's cousin in Karachi

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Peter buys his usual sandwich from Delmar, who teases him about May and tells him to stay in school. When a robber's blast cuts the deli in half, Spider-Man pulls Delmar and Murph out.
stages.whoA: A regular who saves him as Spider-Man
stages.whoB: The deli owner who makes his sandwiches

stages.title: Peter's To-Do List
stages.text: Before his class trip, Peter stops at Delmar's new deli for a headphone adapter and tries his Spanish. Delmar asks if he can come to Europe too.
stages.whoA: A regular off to Europe
stages.whoB: The deli owner who asks to come along

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: G'iah welcomes Beto to New Skrullos and feeds him Skrull food. Later she leaves him waiting in the car during Brogan's rescue, and he calls her a smart lady.
stages.whoA: The rebel who welcomes him
stages.whoB: A newcomer she brings into the rebels

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon readies Beto for the Royal Navy mission and tells him all faith is built on risk. When Gravik kills Pagon, Beto leads a revolt to avenge him.
stages.whoA: The commander he avenges
stages.whoB: An operative he leads on missions

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Beto joins Gravik's rebels and serves on his missions. After Gravik kills Pagon, Beto leads a revolt, calls him a monster, and Gravik kills him.
stages.whoA: His leader, who kills him
stages.whoB: A soldier who turns on him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Beto and Zirksu infiltrate the Royal Navy together under Pagon. They join the revolt against Gravik, and both die in the fight.
stages.whoA: A fellow operative and rebel
stages.whoB: A fellow operative and rebel

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon oversees Brogan taking an American's face. He breaks Brogan out of the torture site, then shoots him in the woods.
stages.whoA: The commander who rescues, then kills him
stages.whoB: An operative he rescues, then kills

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Brogan carries a decoy bag in Gravik's Moscow bombing. Gravik rescues him from Falsworth, suspects he talked and has him killed.
stages.whoA: His leader, who has him killed
stages.whoB: An operative he suspects of talking

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: G'iah hands Brogan the empty decoy bag for the Moscow attack. She drives the car when the rebels rescue him and he is killed.
stages.whoA: The rebel who hands him the decoy bag
stages.whoB: A courier in the Moscow attack

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth takes over Brogan's interrogation, cuts off a finger to prove he is a Skrull and heats his blood. He tells her about Gravik's machine and the Daltons.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who tortures him
stages.whoB: A Skrull she tortures for names

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon sends Zirksu to drive G'iah to the bomb deal in Moscow.
stages.whoA: The rebel he drives to the bomb deal
stages.whoB: Her driver to the bomb deal

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon assigns Zirksu to drive G'iah, then leads him and Beto into the Royal Navy. After Gravik kills Pagon, Zirksu joins the revolt.
stages.whoA: The commander he follows
stages.whoB: An operative he leads

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Zirksu cheers Gravik's return and serves on his missions. In the revolt he tries to stab Gravik, who turns the knife on him.
stages.whoA: His leader, who kills him
stages.whoB: An operative who turns on him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: The anchor stands with Gravik when the Council makes him Skrull General. Gravik later shows him the Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general he backs on the Council
stages.whoB: A Council member who backs him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Stearns and Lawton sit on the Skrull Council together. Both stand with Gravik and hear his Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: A fellow Council member
stages.whoB: A fellow Council member

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth briefs her MI6 boss on the Skrulls and talks him out of a raid. Later she shoots him, shows his staff he is a Skrull and makes him talk.
stages.whoA: The agent who exposes him
stages.whoB: Her MI6 boss, a Skrull mole

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Colonel Rhodes reports Fury AWOL, greets Ritson in England and pushes him to strike Russia. In the hospital, Fury proves Rhodes is a Skrull and kills him.
stages.whoA: His envoy Rhodes, secretly a Skrull
stages.whoB: The President he steers toward war

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury pulls Ritson from his wrecked car and later stops him striking Russia. When Ritson declares war on aliens, Fury scolds him and Ritson tells him to get the Skrulls off Earth.
stages.whoA: The spy who saves him, then scolds him
stages.whoB: The President he saves and argues with

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth holds Rhodes at gunpoint in front of Ritson and asks what he has to lose by waiting. Ritson calls off the strike.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who backs Fury
stages.whoB: The President she talks round

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Lawton nominates Gravik as Skrull General and leads the Council to submit to him. He then shows the Council his Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general she puts in charge
stages.whoB: The Council member who makes him general

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: At a London summit, Lawton demands to know why Colonel Rhodes came instead of President Ritson. Rhodes dismisses the Russian photos of Fury and Hill.
stages.whoA: The U.S. envoy she grills
stages.whoB: The prime minister who grills him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: The Daltons build and test Gravik's Super Skrull machine together. When Falsworth raids their lab, Victor takes Rosa hostage and is shot.
stages.whoA: Her partner, who takes her hostage
stages.whoB: His partner, whom he takes hostage

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Falsworth raids Dr. Dalton's lab, makes her explain her research and burns the place. She shoots Victor when he takes Rosa hostage.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who raids her lab
stages.whoB: A Skrull scientist she captures

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon tells Dr. Dalton the Harvest was not found and hints Gravik is not always right. She tells him to leave.
stages.whoA: The rebel who brings bad news
stages.whoB: The scientist who sends him away

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Victor pulls a gun on Falsworth in his lab, then takes Rosa hostage outside. Falsworth shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The MI6 agent who kills him
stages.whoB: A Skrull scientist she shoots

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon visits the Daltons' lab to report the Harvest is missing, before they test their machine.
stages.whoA: The rebel who reports to the lab
stages.whoB: A scientist at the Daltons' lab

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sergio trades insults with Gravik at the Council and calls the vote for him treason. A guard silences him, he submits, and Gravik shows him the Super Skrull plan.
stages.whoA: The general he gives in to
stages.whoB: A Council member who gives in

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sergio calls Lawton a traitor for nominating Gravik. She tells him to sit down, and a guard chops his throat.
stages.whoA: The Council member he calls a traitor
stages.whoB: The Council member she silences

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Shirley calls Talos after the Council vote and offers to help. She warns Gravik will kill him, but agrees to set up a meeting.
stages.whoA: The old friend she helps
stages.whoB: A Council elder who helps him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Shirley chairs the Council meeting to judge Gravik for Moscow. She refuses to submit to his coup, and he lets her leave in peace.
stages.whoA: The rebel she will not follow
stages.whoB: The elder who defies him

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Lawton nominates Gravik while Shirley is chairing the meeting. Shirley refuses to submit and walks out.
stages.whoA: The member who backs Gravik
stages.whoB: The elder who walks out

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury catches Poprishchin in two lies about his wife and the dirty bombs. When Poprishchin overpowers Talos, Fury shoots him.
stages.whoA: The spy who shoots him
stages.whoB: The bomb maker he shoots

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Poprishchin unmasks the agent called Keller as Talos and calls him a traitor to his people. The two Skrulls fight in the gallery.
stages.whoA: The Skrull he calls a traitor
stages.whoB: The Skrull he fights for the bombs

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury holds Zachary at gunpoint so the Skrull posing as his father lets Talos go. Then he lets Zachary hug his dad.
stages.whoA: The intruder who holds him at gunpoint
stages.whoB: The boy he uses as leverage

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Talos offers Zachary water to calm him. Zachary asks if Talos will kill his dad, and Talos says his dad just has to do the right thing.
stages.whoA: The intruder who tries to calm him
stages.whoB: The boy he tries to calm

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev livestreams Shaun's fight against the men who attack him on a San Francisco bus. He cheers Shaun on and grades the fight for his viewers as it goes.
stages.whoA: The bus passenger whose fight he livestreams
stages.whoB: The vlogger who livestreams his bus fight

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev and Katy are on the bus when Shaun is attacked. With the driver knocked out, Klev refuses to drive, and Katy takes the wheel.
stages.whoA: The passenger who drives the bus he will not
stages.whoB: The vlogger who refuses to drive the bus

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev cheers for Shaun until a man with a blade for an arm joins the attack on the bus, then takes it back. The attacker slices the bus apart as Klev keeps filming.
stages.whoA: The bladed attacker who wrecks his bus
stages.whoB: A vlogger filming on the bus he wrecks

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo and Katy are old friends who once went joyriding in a stolen Mustang. Over dinner Soo urges Katy to use her Berkeley degree, then watches Wong lead Katy away through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend, a valet with a Berkeley degree
stages.whoB: Her old friend, now a lawyer

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo tells Shaun he is wasting his talents parking cars. Two weeks later she mocks his story of saving the world, until Wong calls for Shang-Chi and takes him through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend Shaun, who speaks four languages
stages.whoB: An old friend who says he is wasting his talents

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched blurts out Jen's firing at a family dinner and later barges into her apartment with She-Hulk goods to sign. When Jen says Titania owns the name, he lectures her on trademarks. He also DJs Lulu's wedding and joins the family barbecue.
stages.whoA: His cousin Jen, a lawyer who is also She-Hulk
stages.whoB: Her cousin, a Best Buy manager

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched excitedly greets Bruce when he turns up at the family barbecue, back from Sakaar. When Bruce introduces his son Skaar, Ched asks about the space thing.
stages.whoA: His cousin Bruce, back from Sakaar
stages.whoB: A cousin at the family barbecue

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to bring up Jen's firing, but Ched blurts it out, saying he thought Morris wanted it mentioned. Both are at the family barbecue too.
stages.whoA: Jen's dad, who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca yells at Ched when he blurts out Jen's firing at the family dinner. Both later sit down to the family barbecue with Matt Murdock.
stages.whoA: A relative who scolds him at dinner
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched DJs Lulu's wedding as DJ In-ch-ch-chedible Hulk, hyping her guests at the reception.
stages.whoA: The bride whose wedding he DJs
stages.whoB: The DJ at her wedding

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck calls Jen on a Sunday after Blonsky's inhibitor sends a malfunction alert and asks her to meet him at the retreat as backup. He urges her to hulk out, then leaves once the device is fixed.
stages.whoA: Blonsky's lawyer, his backup at the retreat
stages.whoB: Blonsky's parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck checks on Blonsky at his retreat after an inhibitor alert, fearing he will find the Abomination. Blonsky blames a jolt from an electric fence, and Chuck recalibrates the inhibitor.
stages.whoA: The parolee he supervises
stages.whoB: His parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius echoes Donny's every word when Wong and Jen serve a cease and desist, and backs him in court. When Donny's act lets demons loose, Donny apologizes to him, and Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: The magician he hype-mans
stages.whoB: His hype man at the Mystic Castle

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius sides with Donny against Wong's cease and desist and in court. When demons overrun the magic show, Wong and Jen fight them off and Cornelius gives in.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer suing Donny
stages.whoB: Donny's hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen asks Cornelius if he is just hype-manning Donny when he echoes him. During the demon attack she holds a demon over the pair until Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer, who serves the cease and desist
stages.whoB: Donny's echoing hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Dennis tries to take over Jen's closing at the DA's office and needles She-Hulk at the bar. When he sues the woman who posed as Megan Thee Stallion, Jen testifies he is deluded enough to believe it, and he wins. Later he tells television that he dated her and she was psycho.
stages.whoA: A former coworker who testifies he is deluded
stages.whoB: A smug former coworker at the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Bukowski brings his suit against the shapeshifter who posed as Megan Thee Stallion to GLK&H and picks Pug as his lawyer. Pug calls Jen as a witness and wins him $175,000.
stages.whoA: His lawyer at GLK&H
stages.whoB: A client from the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Runa posed as Megan Thee Stallion and took Bukowski for $175,000 before revealing herself. He sues her, and she loses and is jailed for impersonating a judge.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who scammed him
stages.whoB: The mark she scammed as Megan Thee Stallion

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki jokes that she will kill Dennis when he tries to take Jen's closing, and later tells him to take a lap at the bar. She calls him gross before Jen testifies in his case.
stages.whoA: A paralegal who cannot stand him
stages.whoB: A coworker she cannot stand

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Wong sues Donny for using the Mystic Arts in his shows after he was kicked out of Kamar-Taj. Donny mocks him and wins a ruling to keep performing. When demons pour through, Donny begs Wong for help and agrees to stop.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who sues him
stages.whoB: A Kamar-Taj dropout misusing magic

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen serves Donny with Wong's cease and desist, and he mocks her dating app. During the demon attack she holds a demon over him until he agrees to sign.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer
stages.whoB: The magician she serves with papers

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Donny sends Madisynn through a portal during his show into a realm full of demons. She later testifies about it in Wong's case against him.
stages.whoA: A volunteer he sent through a portal
stages.whoB: The magician who sent her through a portal

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh charms Jen at Lulu's wedding and they share fries after her fight with Titania. After a few dates he draws her blood as she sleeps, copies her phone and ghosts her. A recording of their night is later shown at her awards gala.
stages.whoA: The woman he seduced to steal her blood
stages.whoB: A charming date who ghosts her

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: After taking Jen's blood, Josh texts HulkKing that the job is done. Todd later admits he hired Josh to seduce Jen and steal her blood.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, who hired him
stages.whoB: The man he hired to seduce Jen

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh is a guest of the groom at Lulu's wedding. Lulu pulls Jen away from him to help her clean up inside.
stages.whoA: The bride at the wedding he attends
stages.whoB: A guest of the groom

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen breaks out of her show and confronts K.E.V.I.N., who says he makes every decision. She argues her ending is a mess, and he agrees to her changes. He then locks her out and jokes about seeing her on the big screen.
stages.whoA: The hero who rewrites his ending
stages.whoB: The AI who makes the decisions

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Lulu, Jen's old high school friend, makes her a bridesmaid and makes her promise not to be She-Hulk at the wedding. She dismisses Jen's fears about Titania and puts her to work. After the fight, a tipsy Lulu hugs She-Hulk.
stages.whoA: Her high school friend and bridesmaid
stages.whoB: Her high school friend, the bride

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Titania turns up at Lulu's wedding as a guest. Lulu welcomes her and tells Jen she sounds insane for thinking Titania came to cause trouble.
stages.whoA: A celebrity guest at her wedding
stages.whoB: The bride at the wedding she crashes

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At a family dinner, Melanie offers to give Jen chunky highlights like She-Hulk's hair. At the barbecue she sits by Jen and Matt.
stages.whoA: Jen, whose hair she offers to restyle
stages.whoB: A stylist at the family dinners

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the Walters family barbecue, Melanie eyes Matt and asks why he does not stay longer. She is pulled away to help with the hamburgers.
stages.whoA: Jen's date at the barbecue
stages.whoB: A guest who flirts with him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price rejects Runa's claim of diplomatic immunity, saying Thor's speeches are not admissible. After Runa poses as him to drop the case, he jails her for 60 days.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who impersonates him
stages.whoB: The judge she impersonates

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price presides as Jen gives her closing when Titania crashes in. He rules on Bukowski's case after her testimony, and later sides with Matt against her in the Patilio suit.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who appears in his court
stages.whoB: A judge who hears her cases

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Matt arrives late to Price's court to defend Luke Jacobson. Price agrees the client list stays private, and dismisses the case once Matt shows the plaintiff used jet fuel.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who wins in his court
stages.whoB: The judge who rules his way

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca is at the family dinner after Jen is fired and scolds Ched for bringing it up. At the barbecue Jen tells her not to ask Matt how much money he makes.
stages.whoA: Her niece Jen
stages.whoB: Her Aunt Rebecca

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the barbecue, Rebecca quizzes Matt about his Hell's Kitchen practice. When he says he takes cases that do not pay, she concludes he does not make much money.
stages.whoA: Jen's date, a Hell's Kitchen lawyer
stages.whoB: Jen's aunt, who grills him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to mention Jen's firing before Ched blurts it out. At the barbecue he points out to Rebecca that Matt has his own practice.
stages.whoA: A relative who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative at the family meals

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen testifies in Bukowski's suit that he is deluded enough to have believed Runa was Megan Thee Stallion. Her testimony wins the case, and Runa is jailed.
stages.whoA: The witness who sinks her case
stages.whoB: The scammer in Bukowski's case

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Pug represents Bukowski in his suit against Runa and sees through her when she poses as the judge. He wins full damages for his client.
stages.whoA: The lawyer suing her
stages.whoB: The defendant he beats in court

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball and his crew jump Jen with stolen Asgardian tools, and he tries to take her blood with a needle. It bends on her skin, and the crew flees.
stages.whoA: The Hulk whose blood he fails to take
stages.whoB: A thug who tries to take her blood

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball fails to get She-Hulk's blood, and his crew leader says their boss is going to be mad. He later sits at the Intelligencia gathering where Todd turns out to be its founder, HulkKing.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, the head of Intelligencia
stages.whoB: A member at his Intelligencia gathering

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Guterman writes the fake story of Quentin Beck, a soldier from another Earth, and Beck toasts him for it. In London, Guterman delivers Peter's classmates into the kill zone on Beck's orders, and Beck praises his work.
stages.whoA: His boss, whose fake hero story he writes
stages.whoB: The crew writer who invents his backstory

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Guterman helps Beck's crew fool the world while Peter believes Mysterio is a hero. Once Peter learns the truth, Guterman puts Peter's friends on Tower Bridge, right in the path of Beck's drones.
stages.whoA: The teen hero Beck's crew sets out to stop
stages.whoB: Beck's writer, who puts his friends in danger

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Guterman and Janice both work on Beck's crew and are toasted side by side at its celebration. During the London attack, each reports in when Beck checks on his team.
stages.whoA: A fellow member of Beck's crew
stages.whoB: A fellow member of Beck's crew

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Guterman and William Riva both work on Beck's crew and drink to its success together. In London, Riva launches the drones while Guterman moves the students into place.
stages.whoA: Beck's drone man, a fellow crew member
stages.whoB: Beck's writer, a fellow crew member

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Janice works on Beck's crew, and he toasts her for finding out that Tony Stark left E.D.I.T.H. to a child. During the London attack, she irons his cape and readies his armor while he frets about meeting the Queen.
stages.whoA: Her boss, whose cape and armor she readies
stages.whoB: The crew engineer who readies his suit

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Janice and William Riva both work on Beck's crew and celebrate together after Beck gets E.D.I.T.H. In London, Riva runs the drones while Janice gets Beck's suit ready.
stages.whoA: Beck's drone man, a fellow crew member
stages.whoB: Beck's suit engineer, a fellow crew member

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Jason and Betty co-host Midtown's school news. He asks her on air if she has a homecoming date, and she thanks him but says she already has one. Together they thank Spider-Man for saving the decathlon team.
stages.whoA: His co-host on Midtown's school news
stages.whoB: Her co-host on Midtown's school news

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Back at the news desk after the Blip, Betty scolds Jason for swearing on air. When he complains that his little brother is now older than him, she tells him it's just math.
stages.whoA: His co-host, back after the Blip
stages.whoB: Her co-host, back after the Blip

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Coach Wilson runs Peter's gym class and tells him he is looking good during Captain America's fitness challenge. He later watches over Peter's detention and halfheartedly calls him back when he slips out.
stages.whoA: A student in his gym class and detention
stages.whoB: His gym teacher at Midtown

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: When Peter returns to Midtown after being unmasked, Coach Wilson calls him a murderer and says Mysterio was right. Mr. Harrington tells Peter not to listen to him.
stages.whoA: A former student he now calls a murderer
stages.whoB: His gym teacher, who sides with Mysterio

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Coach Wilson finds Michelle sitting in on detention and asks why she is there when she doesn't have one. She says she just likes coming to sketch people in crisis.
stages.whoA: A student who sits in on detention to sketch
stages.whoB: The gym teacher who runs detention

stages.title: The Daily Bugle
stages.text: Betty interviews her former coach for The Daily Bugle, asking why he never noticed Peter's athletic gifts. Coach Wilson answers that at a science school, two push-ups count as extraordinary.
stages.whoA: A former student who interviews him for the Bugle
stages.whoB: Her old gym coach, interviewed for the Bugle

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Coach Wilson and Mr. Harrington greet the unmasked Peter at Midtown with Mr. Dell. When Wilson keeps calling Peter a murderer and pins the welcome display on Harrington, Harrington calls him a conspiracy theorist.
stages.whoA: A fellow Midtown teacher
stages.whoB: Midtown's gym coach, a fellow teacher

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Michelle hires Jessica to find John, and he phones to warn her off. She finds him in her office holding Malcolm at gunpoint, and he begs her to tell his wife he is a good man before he shoots himself.
stages.whoA: The investigator his wife sent after him
stages.whoB: The missing architect who took Malcolm hostage

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Malcolm walks into Jessica's office and finds John hiding there. John holds him at gunpoint until Jessica arrives and tries to talk him down.
stages.whoA: The neighbor he held at gunpoint
stages.whoB: The panicked architect who held him at gunpoint

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: The Hand sends Elektra to Jessica's office to silence John. She cuts through the door and lifts him off the floor, and he shoots himself before she can take him.
stages.whoA: The Hand's killer who came for him
stages.whoB: The architect she was sent to kill

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Michelle's husband John disappears from their life and she hires Jessica to find him. Jessica later comes to tell her he is dead.
stages.whoA: His wife, who hired Jessica to find him
stages.whoB: Her husband, the missing architect

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: John's daughter Lexi thinks her father abandoned them. She later tells Jessica and Matt how he stopped sleeping, and Matt finds the plans John hid in the family piano.
stages.whoA: His daughter
stages.whoB: Her father, who hid his plans in the piano

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Michelle brings her daughter Lexi when she asks Jessica to find John. They grieve him together at home after Jessica brings the news.
stages.whoA: Her daughter
stages.whoB: Her mother

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Michelle hires Jessica to find her husband, and Jessica first says he is cheating. Jessica takes the case, brings the news of John's death, and later warns her to lock up her house.
stages.whoA: The investigator she hired to find John
stages.whoB: The client whose husband she was hired to find

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Lexi wants nothing to do with Jessica when her mother hires her. Later Lexi tells Jessica about her father's sleepless nights, which leads them to his hidden plans.
stages.whoA: The investigator looking into her father
stages.whoB: The architect's daughter who helped her find his plans

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Matt comes with Jessica to talk to Lexi and tells her about a friend whose father was killed trying to do right. He then finds John's hidden plans inside the family piano.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who found her dad's plans in the piano
stages.whoB: The architect's daughter he talked to about her father

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sarah's younger son runs to greet his uncle Sam in the first days after he comes home. AJ later plays with the shield Sam brings home and celebrates with him when he returns as Captain America.
stages.whoA: His uncle Sam
stages.whoB: His younger nephew

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: AJ is the younger of Sarah's two sons and helps her with the family's food business. Karli threatens Sarah's boys by name, and Sam has her take them somewhere safe.
stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her younger son

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: AJ and his older brother Cass greet their uncle Sam together and sneak off to play video games. They find Captain America's shield at home and later gang up on Bucky at the party.
stages.whoA: His older brother
stages.whoB: His younger brother

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: AJ and Cass drop the shield and run when Bucky walks into the house. At the party for Sam, they play fight with Bucky and AJ hangs from his metal arm.
stages.whoA: Uncle Sam's friend with the metal arm
stages.whoB: Sam's nephew who hangs off his arm

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Cass runs to hug his uncle Sam home. Later he plays with Sam's shield and chases him as he trains with it, and celebrates when Sam comes home as Captain America.
stages.whoA: His uncle Sam
stages.whoB: His older nephew

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Cass is Sarah's older son, helping her pack the family's food and getting yelled at over the Cheerios. Karli threatens Sarah's boys by name, so Sarah takes them somewhere safe.
stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her older son

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Cass and AJ are caught playing with the shield when Bucky walks in. At the party for Sam, the boys playfully gang up on Bucky.
stages.whoA: Uncle Sam's friend Bucky
stages.whoB: Sam's nephew who play fights him

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam learns Ayla has flight training while Diego flies the council off in a stolen helicopter. On his countdown she grabs the controls as he pulls Diego out, and afterward she thanks him for all of them.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who saved the council
stages.whoB: The council member who took the controls

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Diego poses as the pilot and flies Ayla and the council off in their own helicopter. When Sam pulls him out, she takes the controls and keeps it from crashing.
stages.whoA: The Flag Smasher who hijacked her helicopter
stages.whoB: The council member who took back the controls

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Diego swears loyalty to Karli in the Munich safe house and follows her from depot raids to the camp fight. He flies the council's helicopter for her attack in New York.
stages.whoA: His leader in the Flag Smashers
stages.whoB: One of her super soldiers

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Diego fights Falcon at the camp ambush. In New York he hijacks the council's helicopter and shoots at Sam, who drags him into the Hudson and later pulls him out to be arrested.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who dragged him into the Hudson
stages.whoB: The Flag Smasher who hijacked the council's helicopter

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: At the camp ambush, Diego is knocked down by Walker's thrown shield, kicks him and pulls a knife. Walker strips the knife away and throws him off.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who disarmed him
stages.whoB: A Flag Smasher he fought at the camp

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: At the camp ambush, Diego and another Flag Smasher overpower Battlestar and tie him up. Lemar dies in the same fight.
stages.whoA: The Battlestar he helped overpower
stages.whoB: A Flag Smasher who tied him up

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dovich is Karli's right hand from the bank job to New York. He comforts her when Donya dies but balks when she bombs a depot with people inside, and questions her deal with Batroc.
stages.whoA: The leader he follows and questions
stages.whoB: Her right hand in the Flag Smashers

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dovich fights Bucky on the stolen trucks in Munich and again on the riverbank in New York. Bucky and Walker then lure him into a police trap with the Flag Smashers' own app.
stages.whoA: The super soldier who fought him and trapped him
stages.whoB: Karli's right hand he fought and trapped

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: At the camp, Walker bends Dovich's pipe and throws him down the stairs, and Dovich runs. In New York he beats on Walker's shield, then walks into Walker and Bucky's trap.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who threw him down the stairs
stages.whoB: The Flag Smasher he trapped in New York

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: After a Flag Smasher bank job, Torres holds a masked super soldier at gunpoint. The man tears the gun away and knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The officer he knocked out after the bank job
stages.whoB: The masked Flag Smasher who knocked him out

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dovich doubts Karli's choice to bring Batroc into the New York attack. During the fight on the riverbank, Batroc's smoke bombs let Dovich and the others escape.
stages.whoA: The hired criminal he did not trust
stages.whoB: Karli's right hand who doubted him

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dovich sends Diego and Lennox to load the second van at a raided GRC depot. They fight Sam, Bucky and Walker side by side at the camp ambush.
stages.whoA: A fellow Flag Smasher
stages.whoB: Karli's right hand

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Dovich sends Lennox and Diego to load the second van at a raided GRC depot. In New York, Dovich warns Karli that Lennox has stopped answering.
stages.whoA: A fellow Flag Smasher
stages.whoB: Karli's right hand

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Lennox drives for Karli in Munich and swears loyalty to her. He follows her through the depot raids and herds hostages for her in New York before he dies.
stages.whoA: His leader in the Flag Smashers
stages.whoB: One of her super soldiers

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: At the camp ambush, Lennox leaps at Bucky on the stairs. Bucky throws him down the steps and through a brick wall and tells him to stay down.
stages.whoA: The super soldier who threw him through a wall
stages.whoB: A Flag Smasher he put through a wall

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Lennox drives a stolen truck in Munich and swerves to shake Falcon off the side. They meet again in the fight at the camp.
stages.whoA: The Falcon he tried to shake off his truck
stages.whoB: The Flag Smasher driving the truck

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: As the Flag Smashers herd hostages in New York, Sharon bumps into Lennox and apologizes. She has slipped mercury vapor onto him, and he dies at the wheel of his van.
stages.whoA: The woman who poisoned him
stages.whoB: The Flag Smasher she poisoned

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: He leads the Flag Smashers' oath of loyalty to Karli in the Munich safe house. When the Power Broker's men arrive, he stays behind to hold them off so she can escape.
stages.whoA: The leader he died for
stages.whoB: The Flag Smasher who died so she could escape

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: On the stolen trucks in Munich, he and another Flag Smasher hold Bucky back so Karli can fight Falcon.
stages.whoA: The super soldier he held back
stages.whoB: A Flag Smasher who pinned him

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: When Walker and Battlestar join the Munich fight, he grabs Battlestar. Walker shoots him to free Lemar.
stages.whoA: The Battlestar he grabbed
stages.whoB: A Flag Smasher who grabbed him

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Walker throws his shield into the Munich fight and shoots the Flag Smasher holding Battlestar. The man heals in time for the oath that night.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who shot him
stages.whoB: A Flag Smasher he shot

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Oeznik greets Zemo warmly when he is freed and flies him wherever he asks. With Zemo in the Raft, Oeznik bombs the van carrying the captured Flag Smashers.
stages.whoA: The Baron he serves
stages.whoB: His loyal butler

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Oeznik meets Sam with Zemo and Bucky at the airport and flies them to Madripoor. He serves them on Zemo's jet and takes them on toward Riga.
stages.whoA: His master's guest on the jet
stages.whoB: Zemo's butler who flew them

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Oeznik meets Bucky, Sam and Zemo at the airport and flies them to Madripoor and on toward Riga on Zemo's jet.
stages.whoA: His master's guest on the jet
stages.whoB: Zemo's butler who flew them

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: John's wife steadies him before his debut as Captain America and comforts him after the hearing strips him of it. She cheers when he walks out as U.S. Agent.
stages.whoA: His wife
stages.whoB: Her husband, the new Captain America

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: In John's memories, Olivia finds him on his phone while their baby cries, and he snaps at her. Bucky reminds John that Olivia has left him and taken their son.
stages.whoA: The wife who left him
stages.whoB: Her husband, who drove her away

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Olivia passes Lemar outside John's old locker room before the debut, and he asks whether John has thrown up yet.
stages.whoA: Her husband's best friend
stages.whoB: His best friend's wife

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Valentina sits down between Olivia and John after his hearing. Later Olivia waits with her for John's new suit and cheers when Valentina names him U.S. Agent.
stages.whoA: The woman who recruited her husband
stages.whoB: The wife of her new U.S. Agent

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Major Sparr brings General Ross the gamma sickness lead that points to Brazil and stays at his side as his teams hunt Banner. At Culver she turns to him in surprise when Betty calls him her father.
stages.whoA: The general she serves in the hunt for Banner
stages.whoB: His aide, who runs the hunt for Banner with him

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Sparr briefs Blonsky's strike team before the Brazil raid, and Blonsky takes Betty's photo from her hand in Banner's apartment. Later, hungry for more power, he knocks her out while she questions Sterns.
stages.whoA: The soldier on loan to the hunt, who knocks her out
stages.whoB: Ross's aide, whom he knocks out

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Sparr traces Banner's messages to Sterns, and the Army closes in on his lab. After Banner's capture she asks Sterns if he can make more like Banner, until Blonsky knocks her out.
stages.whoA: The scientist she tracks down and questions
stages.whoB: The Army major who questions him

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Sparr helps Ross hunt Banner from the Brazil raid to the Culver ambush. She then traces his messages to Sterns, which leads to his capture.
stages.whoA: The fugitive scientist she hunts
stages.whoB: Ross's aide in the hunt for him

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Dar-Benn comes to Tarnax IV with a treaty that is not what Dro'ge agreed to, offering to relocate the Skrulls into the Kree Empire. When Carol arrives, Dar-Benn blames the Skrulls and strips the planet's air, leaving Dro'ge's people nowhere to go.
stages.whoA: The Kree leader who destroys his colony's world
stages.whoB: The Skrull emperor whose world she takes

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol tells Emperor Dro'ge to evacuate as Tarnax IV is torn apart, and he answers that his people have nowhere to go. Aboard her ship he tells her the treaty was good and her help failed, then accepts the safe place her friend can offer.
stages.whoA: The hero whose help he blames for his loss
stages.whoB: The Skrull emperor she fails to protect

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Answering Carol's call, Valkyrie arrives to take Dro'ge and his surviving Skrulls to a safe new home. Dro'ge thanks her as they leave.
stages.whoA: The Asgardian king who gives his people refuge
stages.whoB: The Skrull emperor she takes to safety

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Zubair, Madani's partner in Kandahar, finds that American soldiers are trafficking heroin, and she promises him protection. After he is murdered, Madani blames herself and hunts his killers in New York until she learns Frank fired the shot.
stages.whoA: His Homeland Security partner, who hunts his killers
stages.whoB: Her Afghan police partner, whose murder she investigates

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Frank is in the room in Kandahar as Cerberus Squad tortures Zubair, who begs that he is a policeman with a family. On Agent Orange's order, Frank shoots him and digs out the bullet to hide the evidence.
stages.whoA: The Cerberus soldier who executes him
stages.whoB: The Afghan policeman he executed in Kandahar

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: As Agent Orange, Rawlins questions Zubair about who else knows of the heroin route and threatens his family. When Zubair gives him nothing, Rawlins orders him killed.
stages.whoA: The CIA man who orders his execution
stages.whoB: The policeman he had tortured and killed

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Billy's crew robs ReadyQuick with the clerk as their inside man, and Billy takes him away as a fake hostage. At the hideout, after Frank wrecks the getaway, Billy shoots him when he wants out.
stages.whoA: The crew leader who uses him, then kills him
stages.whoB: His inside man at ReadyQuick

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Bobby holds the ReadyQuick staff at gunpoint while the clerk plays a hostage. Back at the hideout Bobby cuts him loose, and both are shot by Billy after they turn on him.
stages.whoA: A crew gunman who cuts him loose
stages.whoB: The inside man he cuts loose

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Walsh hurt Billy as a boy at the Ray of Hope Group Home. Years later Billy turns up in his living room, and over spiked coffee Walsh defends himself and mocks Billy's scarred face until Billy kills him.
stages.whoA: The boy he abused, who comes back and kills him
stages.whoB: The group home worker who abused him

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Bobby drinks with Billy and the other veterans, helps him beat a tow truck driver, then pitches robbing ReadyQuick. After Frank wrecks the getaway, Bobby blames Billy for the mess, and Billy shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The crew leader who kills him
stages.whoB: A crew gunman who pitches the heist

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Bruce sleeps off a drunk in the Larkville cells next to Frank. When armed men lay siege to the station, Bruce takes a shotgun and cheers as Frank kills the attackers.
stages.whoA: The cellmate who saves the station
stages.whoB: The drunk cellmate who helps defend the station

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Lewis nearly shoots his father by accident in the basement, and his father holds him as he breaks down. Later they watch an old Ali fight, and his father urges Lewis to stop fighting a war that is over.
stages.whoA: His son, a troubled veteran
stages.whoB: His father, who tries to bring him back

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Anderson visits his son at a driving range, presses him to come home and hints at a sin the church cannot forgive. When Frank holds David hostage, Anderson threatens to kill Frank, and David learns his parents ordered the killings.
stages.whoA: His father, who hides his secret at any cost
stages.whoB: His son, the senator he grooms for power

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: David's mother asks if he is hurt when Frank calls his parents on David's phone, holding him hostage. Listening to Frank, David realizes his mother and father had people murdered to keep his secret.
stages.whoA: His mother, who had people killed over his secret
stages.whoB: Her son, whom she shields whatever the cost

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank poses as a police officer, punches his way into David's apartment and takes him hostage, sure he is behind Pilgrim's killings. Frank uses him to make the Schultzes trade for Amy.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who kidnaps him
stages.whoB: The senator he kidnaps as leverage

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Curtis guards David while Frank goes after Pilgrim, and David confides that his parents were ashamed of him. Curtis sets him free and hands him to Mahoney, and David asks that Curtis not be arrested.
stages.whoA: Frank's friend, who guards him and lets him go
stages.whoB: The senator he guards, then sets free

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Donny shares his grandmother's sandwiches with the quiet worker he knows as Pete, who tells him he is not looking for a friend. When the crew tries to bury Donny in concrete, Frank kills them and throws him a rope and a bag of cash marked to leave town.
stages.whoA: The quiet coworker Pete, who saves his life
stages.whoB: A young coworker he saves from the crew

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Karen asks Ed for a favor, and he lets her and Madani see three women's bodies before they are processed. His findings show the women were executed at close range, not caught in Frank's crossfire.
stages.whoA: The investigator who calls in a favor
stages.whoB: A morgue assistant who owes her a look

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Ed shows Madani the gunpowder grains around the three victims' wounds, and she concludes they were executed. She tells him he should work with the police, and he says they will not hire him and call him Creepy Ed.
stages.whoA: The Homeland agent he helps at the morgue
stages.whoB: A morgue assistant who reads the wounds for her

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Danny takes Pilgrim's five million dollar bounty on Frank and Amy and puts the word out, but also tells his old gang that Pilgrim is back. He lures Pilgrim to his club for an ambush, and when Pilgrim kills the gang, Danny runs and Pilgrim shoots him in the back.
stages.whoA: The gang's old hero, whose trust he betrays
stages.whoB: A young gang member who once idolized him

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Isaac attends Curtis's veterans' group, where Curtis keeps the peace when Isaac and O'Connor trade insults. Isaac asks what became of the goat in Curtis's story about Cassius.
stages.whoA: The counselor who runs his veterans' group
stages.whoB: A veteran in his support group

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Isaac and Lewis sit together in Curtis's support group. After Isaac joins the Anvil detail guarding Senator Ori, Lewis shoots him through his apartment door and takes his gear.
stages.whoA: A fellow veteran from group, who kills him
stages.whoB: A groupmate he kills on the way to Ori

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy puts Isaac, one of his Anvil men, on Senator Ori's detail with orders to subdue Lewis humanely. After Lewis kills Isaac, Mahoney tells Billy one of his men is dead.
stages.whoA: His boss at Anvil
stages.whoB: An Anvil guard on Ori's detail

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Jake drinks with Billy at McFeeney's, says he knows who Billy is and shakes his hand. He helps Billy win back Jimbo's car and trains with the crew for the check cashing job, then slips away the night before the robbery.
stages.whoA: The scarred fugitive whose crew he joins
stages.whoB: A veteran who joins his crew, then talks

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Jake attends Curtis's veterans' group and snaps at Madani until Curtis steps in. After Frank grabs him, Curtis dresses his wounds and begs him not to stand between Billy and Frank, and Jake gives up the crew's plans.
stages.whoA: The group leader who tends his wounds
stages.whoB: A veteran from his group who runs with Billy

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank and Curtis snatch Jake off the street when he goes looking for drugs. Frank tortures him until he names the check cashing target and the warehouse, then beats him again after the robbery goes wrong.
stages.whoA: The man who tortures him for Billy's plans
stages.whoB: A veteran in Billy's crew he forces to talk

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: In private sessions, Jake tells Krista that civilian life feels like a monster eating him alive. She tells him real change is painful, while Billy secretly listens in.
stages.whoA: His therapist
stages.whoB: A veteran patient she counsels

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Jake mocks Madani as a civilian tourist at Curtis's group, then apologizes when she answers him. Later she watches Frank torture him and makes Frank stop.
stages.whoA: A Homeland agent he mocks, then faces
stages.whoB: A veteran Frank tortures for Billy's plans

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Jake and Jimbo share Curtis's group and a night at McFeeney's with Billy. When Jimbo's car is towed, Jake rides with Billy to cut off the truck and get it back.
stages.whoA: A buddy from the veterans' group
stages.whoB: A buddy from the veterans' group

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Jake and Philip train together in Billy's crew for the check cashing job. Jake sneaks off before the robbery, while Philip takes the sniper post.
stages.whoA: A fellow member of Billy's crew
stages.whoB: A fellow member of Billy's crew

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Curtis tells Jimbo he can appeal his discharge and buys him a pair of glasses. When Jimbo is arrested, Curtis is the one he calls, and Curtis tells him to keep quiet.
stages.whoA: The group leader who looks out for him
stages.whoB: A homeless veteran in his group

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Billy drinks with Jimbo and the other veterans, then leads them after the tow truck that took Jimbo's car. Billy beats the driver and tells Jimbo to change his plates and drive to Texas.
stages.whoA: Jake's scarred buddy who gets his car back
stages.whoB: A veteran he helps get his car back

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Turk comes to Kazan's gym asking for Konchevsky, and Kazan tells him Konchevsky is dead. Kazan holds Turk and makes him set up a trap for Frank at his shop.
stages.whoA: A hustler he holds to bait a trap
stages.whoB: The Russian boss who holds him hostage

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank skips Kazan's trap and walks into the gym instead. He beats Kazan's men and chokes Kazan with a barbell until he gives up Nikolai Poloznev's name.
stages.whoA: The man who storms his gym
stages.whoB: A Russian boss he forces to talk

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: After Frank leaves the gym, the Schultzes' soft-spoken hitman arrives and kills Kazan and his remaining men so they cannot talk.
stages.whoA: The hitman who kills him
stages.whoB: A Russian boss he silences

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Ogden watches the girl calling herself Rachel at the station, and she talks five dollars out of him for a soda. After he is shot, she helps keep pressure on his wound.
stages.whoA: The girl he guards who helps save him
stages.whoB: The deputy who guards her

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Ogden guards Frank after the motel shootout. When the sheriff thinks of handing Frank and the girl over, the wounded Ogden refuses, and Frank holds off the attackers.
stages.whoA: The prisoner who defends the station
stages.whoB: The deputy who refuses to give him up

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: The man besieging the station shoots Ogden in the chest as he tries to drive out for help. He tells the sheriff Ogden will bleed out in hours without a doctor.
stages.whoA: The gunman who shoots him
stages.whoB: A deputy he shoots

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Leo meets Frank as Pete, who helps around the house and fixes things with her. When men come for her family, he calls her phone and guides her to a safe spot.
stages.whoA: Pete, the family friend who helps her
stages.whoB: Sarah's daughter, whom he helps

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Leo lives with her mother Sarah after her father's death. When a fake officer comes, Sarah signals her to hide, and they are reunited after Sarah is freed.
stages.whoA: Her mother
stages.whoB: Her daughter

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Leo believes her father David is dead. He comes to the playground in Frank's place, and she runs to hug him, then celebrates his return home.
stages.whoA: Her father, alive after all
stages.whoB: His daughter

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Marlena's crew works for a soft-spoken man hunting a runaway girl, and she reports to him after the roadhouse fight. He frees her from her cell, then strangles her for her failures.
stages.whoA: The employer who frees, then kills her
stages.whoB: A mercenary he hires, then kills

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank beats Marlena's crew at Lola's Roadhouse and again at the Tides Motel, where he wounds her. They are jailed together in Larkville and trade words in the cell.
stages.whoA: The drifter who keeps beating her crew
stages.whoB: The mercenary who hunts the girl

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Marlena corners the girl calling herself Rachel in the roadhouse restroom, and again at the motel. In jail, the girl begs not to share a cell with her.
stages.whoA: Her target
stages.whoB: The mercenary hunting her

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Moke parties at Valhalla with Billy's crew. When he grabs a woman, Billy tells him to play nice with their guests.
stages.whoA: The boss of his crew
stages.whoB: A member of his crew

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank ambushes Moke in his car while he waits on a job for Billy. Moke shoots Frank's vest, and Frank kills him and unlocks his phone with his finger.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him
stages.whoB: A crew member he kills for a lead

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Frank breaks into Bennett's quarters at Fort Bryon and beats him as he begs for his life. Frank vanishes into the smoke when armed men storm the room.
stages.whoA: The man who hunts him down
stages.whoB: A Cerberus colonel he hunts

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Billy leads the team that saves Bennett from Frank and promises to hide him. At a cheap motel, Bennett finds his mistress dead, and Billy stabs him to death.
stages.whoA: The rescuer who kills him
stages.whoB: A Cerberus partner he kills

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Bennett confronts Rawlins at his country house, sure he knew Frank was coming. Rawlins promises him a new life and sends him off with Billy.
stages.whoA: His Cerberus partner, who betrays him
stages.whoB: An old Cerberus partner he has killed

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Posing as a waitress, Amy shows Poloznev the photos of David Schultz he paid for. He sends his bodyguards after her.
stages.whoA: A waitress who shows him his photos
stages.whoB: The man who paid for her photos

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank takes the wheel of Poloznev's car and drives him to the docks. Poloznev explains his plan against the Schultzes, and Frank spares him on the condition that he leave the country.
stages.whoA: The man who kidnaps, then spares him
stages.whoB: The man behind the photos he spares

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: As Poloznev prepares to leave the country, the Schultzes' hitman steps into his elevator and kills him and his bodyguards.
stages.whoA: The hitman who kills him
stages.whoB: A schemer he kills for the Schultzes

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: O'Connor praises Lewis's anger in Curtis's group and hands him a gun rights pamphlet. They protest together until O'Connor walks away from Lewis's arrest, and Lewis, learning his war stories are lies, kills him.
stages.whoA: The young veteran he radicalizes
stages.whoB: The fake veteran who leads him astray

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: O'Connor spouts extremist talk in Curtis's group, and Curtis pushes back on him. Curtis pulls his records and tells Lewis that O'Connor never went to Vietnam.
stages.whoA: The group leader who exposes him
stages.whoB: A loudmouth in his group

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Paulie calls Frank the gimp and mocks him at the construction site. When Paulie and his friends try to drown Donny in cement, Frank beats them and shoots Paulie as he tries to flee.
stages.whoA: A silent coworker who kills him
stages.whoB: A coworker he kills to save Donny

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Philip serves as the sniper in Billy's crew during the check cashing heist and the spree that follows. He is one of the last men left at Valhalla for Billy's ambush.
stages.whoA: The boss of his crew
stages.whoB: His crew's sniper

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Curtis knocks Philip out on the rooftop during the heist. At Valhalla, Curtis shoots him in the leg, then tries to save him as he bleeds to death.
stages.whoA: The man who shoots him, then tries to save him
stages.whoB: A sniper he shoots in self defense

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Philip fires on Frank from a rooftop during the check cashing heist and hits his own man by mistake. He later joins Billy's ambush on Frank at Valhalla.
stages.whoA: The man he shoots at
stages.whoB: A sniper in Billy's crew

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Rebecca, gravely ill, asks John how long he will be gone. He confesses his real name is Robert and his violent past, and she tells him he is loved. She dies while he is away.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His late wife

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Eliza visits Rebecca's sickbed, and Rebecca thanks her for paying for her treatment. Eliza later tells John that Rebecca was like a daughter to her.
stages.whoA: The patron who pays for her care
stages.whoB: A sick woman she treats like a daughter

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Lemuel and his brother play a board game at the foot of their mother's sickbed.
stages.whoA: Her son
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Lemuel fetches his father from the basement when the Schultzes arrive. After his mother dies, he calls John from the Schultzes' house, and John comes back to take him home.
stages.whoA: His father
stages.whoB: His son

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Eliza keeps Lemuel and his brother after their mother dies and says she could do something with him. She and Anderson plan to keep the boys while John's life pays for their future.
stages.whoA: The patron who keeps him as leverage
stages.whoB: A boy she holds over his father

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Anderson takes in Lemuel and his brother after their mother dies, sending them to bed after Lemuel's call to John. He uses the boys to keep John fighting for the Schultzes.
stages.whoA: The patron who keeps him as leverage
stages.whoB: A boy he holds over his father

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Ringo works the door at Lola's while Beth tends bar. He throws out a drunk on her word, and when mercenaries start a brawl, she calls him in to deal with them.
stages.whoA: A bartender he works beside
stages.whoB: The roadhouse bouncer

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Ringo first sizes Frank up after a bar fight, until Beth vouches for him. Later he fights beside Frank against the mercenaries and dies saving him.
stages.whoA: A stranger he fights beside
stages.whoB: The bouncer who dies fighting beside him

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Roy books Frank, under the name Castiglione, for four killings at a motel and keeps him locked up. When gunmen besiege the station, Roy finally frees him, and Frank holds them off and saves Roy's deputy.
stages.whoA: The prisoner who saves his station
stages.whoB: The sheriff who jails him, then trusts him

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Roy questions the girl who calls herself Rachel and catches her many fake names. She admits that Frank saved her, and once the siege ends Roy lets her leave with him.
stages.whoA: A runaway with too many names
stages.whoB: The sheriff who questions her

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: A quiet man in a suit comes with a lieutenant to claim Roy's prisoners and talks to him about his oath before God. Roy refuses, and the man's gunmen lay siege to the station.
stages.whoA: The man who besieges his station
stages.whoB: A sheriff who will not hand over Frank

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank calls Madani from Roy's station. She arrives with Homeland Security to end the siege, and Roy lets her take Frank and leave him off the books.
stages.whoA: The Homeland agent who ends the siege
stages.whoB: The sheriff who hands over Frank

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: A quiet man holds Sergei tied to a chair and listens as he takes Amy's call and sets up a meeting at Lola's Roadhouse. Sergei begs to be let go, and the man strangles him, saying he promised only peace.
stages.whoA: The captor who strangles him
stages.whoB: A Russian he tortures and kills

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Sergei paid Fiona's crew for a set of photos. Amy calls him to say the crew is dead, demands her money, and sets a meeting at Lola's Roadhouse, not knowing his captor is listening.
stages.whoA: A girl from the crew he hired
stages.whoB: The Russian who hired her crew

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Amy turns to her old friend from Fiona's crew for a way out of the city, and Shantel takes her cash. Shantel then sells her out to bounty hunters, and Amy kicks her on the way out.
stages.whoA: An old friend who sells her out
stages.whoB: An old friend from Fiona's crew

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Shantel calls bounty hunters chasing the price on Frank and Amy. Frank fights them off and comes back with Amy, who leaves Shantel on the floor.
stages.whoA: The man with a price on his head
stages.whoB: The grifter who sells out Amy

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Russo meets his old Anvil men, now wanted for shooting Iraqi civilians, and offers each $500,000 for an off-book kill. When Homeland springs a trap at the warehouse, Russo pushes him into the line of fire to cover his own escape.
stages.whoA: His old boss, who sacrifices him
stages.whoB: An ex-Anvil man he hires and sacrifices

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Madani's Homeland team lies in wait at the warehouse and orders the masked gunmen to surrender. When Russo shoves him out of cover, Madani shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The Homeland agent who shoots him
stages.whoB: A masked gunman she kills

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Both lost their place at Anvil over the shooting in Iraq and take Russo's job together. They storm the warehouse side by side and both die there.
stages.whoA: A fellow disgraced contractor
stages.whoB: A fellow disgraced contractor

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Russo offers his old Anvil men $500,000 each for an off-book kill, and the contractor argues that they only did what they were paid for in Iraq. At the warehouse he is shot in the leg and begs Russo to come back, and Russo shoots him in the head.
stages.whoA: His old boss, who kills him
stages.whoB: An ex-Anvil man he hires and kills

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Madani's team traps the masked gunmen at the warehouse. In the firefight she shoots him in the leg as he runs for the exit.
stages.whoA: The Homeland agent who traps his team
stages.whoB: A masked gunman she wounds

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Stein and Madani spring the trap at the warehouse. The contractors trade fire with Stein's agents and lose two men before they break and run.
stages.whoA: A Homeland agent in the trap
stages.whoB: A gunman in the warehouse fight

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Ori and Karen argue about guns on Ricky Langtry's show until the bomber calls in and threatens them both. When the bomber storms their interview, Ori shoves Karen at him to escape, and Karen later tells Mahoney the truth.
stages.whoA: The reporter who exposes him
stages.whoB: The senator who shoves her at a bomber

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Lewis calls the radio show to attack Ori as a traitor who would take Americans' guns. He later blasts into Ori's hotel suite, kills his guards and aims to kill him.
stages.whoA: The bomber who tries to kill him
stages.whoB: A politician he targets

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Ori hires Russo's Anvil to guard him despite his stand against guns. Russo warns him to stay upstairs, but Ori insists on a public interview, and the bomber gets past Anvil's men.
stages.whoA: The contractor guarding him
stages.whoB: A senator who hires Anvil

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: On the radio, Ori holds up Frank's killings as proof that guns are poison. Frank then takes a bullet for him in his hotel suite, and Ori tells the police that he went for help.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, who saves his life
stages.whoB: A senator who lies about him

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Sarah struggles with her angry son after David's apparent death and finds a knife in his backpack. Anvil men take them both after Zach's call to the tip line, and she shields him through the exchange and their reunion with David.
stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her son

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: David watches his angry son from hidden cameras and begs Frank to reach him. When Zach and Sarah are traded for him, Zach sees his father alive, and the family is finally reunited.
stages.whoA: His father, back from the dead
stages.whoB: His son

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Zach shoves past Pete at first, but Pete gets through to him over the knife in his backpack, and Zach breaks down and admits he is scared. When he learns Pete is the Punisher, Zach calls the tip line, and Frank walks into the exchange that frees him.
stages.whoA: Pete, the man who reaches him
stages.whoB: Sarah's angry son

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Fandral follows Thor to Jotunheim and is badly wounded there. After Thor is banished, Fandral defies Loki, finds Thor in New Mexico, and fights the Destroyer while Thor saves the town.
stages.whoA: His friend and prince
stages.whoB: One of the Warriors Three

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Fandral and Thor end the war on Vanaheim and put down a riot in the dungeons. Fandral helps Thor slip away from Asgard and holds off the pursuing guards.
stages.whoA: His friend, whom he helps escape
stages.whoB: A friend who covers his escape

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Fandral and Volstagg fight the Frost Giants together, and Volstagg carries the wounded Fandral home. On Earth they throw Volstagg at the Destroyer, and Fandral drags him from a burning cafe.
stages.whoA: Volstagg, a fellow warrior
stages.whoB: Fandral, a fellow warrior

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: They fight on Vanaheim, guard the prisoners, and quell the dungeon riot side by side. Both help Thor escape Asgard against Odin's orders.
stages.whoA: Volstagg, his old comrade
stages.whoB: Fandral, his old comrade

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Fandral and Volstagg are keeping watch at the Bifrost when Hela arrives. She kills them both together.
stages.whoA: His comrade, killed beside him
stages.whoB: His comrade, killed beside him

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Fandral rides to Jotunheim with Sif and later holds her back when she confronts Loki. They go to Earth together and battle the Destroyer.
stages.whoA: Lady Sif, a fellow warrior
stages.whoB: One of the Warriors Three

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Sif and Fandral fight the Marauders on Vanaheim and join Thor's plan to free Jane from Asgard.
stages.whoA: Lady Sif, a fellow warrior
stages.whoB: A fellow warrior

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Fandral teases Loki on the way to Jotunheim. When Loki takes the throne and refuses to bring Thor back, Fandral defies the new king and goes to Earth.
stages.whoA: Thor's brother, a king he defies
stages.whoB: A warrior who defies him

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Fandral is sure Loki will betray Thor. He mocks Loki's clumsy fall into the escape skiff and hands him the controls.
stages.whoA: Thor's brother, whom he mistrusts
stages.whoB: A warrior who mocks him

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall lets the warriors cross to Jotunheim, and later to Earth to bring Thor home against Loki's orders.
stages.whoA: The gatekeeper who lets them pass
stages.whoB: A warrior he lets cross

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Heimdall and Fandral join Thor's secret plan to get Jane out of Asgard.
stages.whoA: The gatekeeper in Thor's plan
stages.whoB: A warrior in Thor's plan

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Hela arrives at the Bifrost, and Fandral draws his sword. She kills him and Volstagg with her blades.
stages.whoA: The goddess who kills him
stages.whoB: A warrior she kills

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Volstagg follows Thor to Jotunheim and fights the Frost Giants. After Thor is banished, Volstagg defies Loki, finds him in New Mexico, and battles the Destroyer.
stages.whoA: His friend and prince
stages.whoB: One of the Warriors Three

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Volstagg fights beside Thor on Vanaheim and tells the tavern tall tales of the battle. He then holds off the Einherjar so Thor can flee Asgard.
stages.whoA: His friend, whom he helps escape
stages.whoB: A friend who holds off the guards

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Volstagg rides to Jotunheim with Sif and goes with her to Earth to bring Thor home. They battle the Destroyer together.
stages.whoA: Lady Sif, a fellow warrior
stages.whoB: One of the Warriors Three

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Sif and Volstagg fight on Vanaheim and both help Thor escape. Afterward they take the Aether to the Collector together.
stages.whoA: Lady Sif, who goes with him to Knowhere
stages.whoB: The warrior who goes with her to Knowhere

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Volstagg jokes at Loki's expense on the way to Jotunheim. When Loki takes the throne, Volstagg speaks up against him and then defies him to bring Thor home.
stages.whoA: Thor's brother, a king he defies
stages.whoB: A warrior who defies him

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Volstagg warns Loki that if he even thinks about betraying Thor, he will kill him. Loki answers that there will be a line.
stages.whoA: Thor's brother, whom he threatens
stages.whoB: A warrior who threatens him

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall lets the warriors cross to Jotunheim, and later to Earth to bring Thor home against Loki's orders.
stages.whoA: The gatekeeper who lets them pass
stages.whoB: A warrior he lets cross

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Heimdall and Volstagg join Thor's secret plan to get Jane out of Asgard.
stages.whoA: The gatekeeper in Thor's plan
stages.whoB: A warrior in Thor's plan

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Hela arrives at the Bifrost, and Volstagg demands to know who she is and what she has done with Thor. She kills him and Fandral.
stages.whoA: The goddess who kills him
stages.whoB: A warrior she kills

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Volstagg and Sif bring the Aether to Knowhere. Volstagg explains that two Infinity Stones are unwise to keep together, and the Collector promises to keep it safe.
stages.whoA: The collector who takes the Aether
stages.whoB: An Asgardian who brings him the Aether

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Starving, Gorr begs his god Rapu for the eternal reward, but Rapu laughs and says suffering is all his people are for. Gorr renounces him, Rapu tries to strangle him, and Gorr kills him with the Necrosword.
stages.whoA: His last disciple, who kills him
stages.whoB: The god he worshipped, then killed first

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Ages ago, King Bor leads Asgard's armies against Malekith, who seeks to plunge the universe into darkness with the Aether. Bor takes the Aether and wins, and Malekith escapes by sacrificing his own people.
stages.whoA: The Dark Elf king he defeats
stages.whoB: The Asgardian king who defeats him

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Odin tells how his father, King Bor, led Asgard's armies against Malekith. Bor's victory brought a peace that lasted thousands of years.
stages.whoA: His son, who tells of his war
stages.whoB: His father, a past king of Asgard

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: The Client pays Paladin to bring in Vision intact, hacks his comms to scold him, and fires him after repeated failures. Paladin keeps to his contract anyway, and the Client finally has him deliver Vision.
stages.whoA: The bounty hunter he hires, then fires
stages.whoB: The client who hires him to catch Vision

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: The Client pays bounty hunters and the Ten Rings to capture Vision, then speaks to him himself, offering him a heart. His map to Vision's source code carries a contract that forces Vision to surrender to him.
stages.whoA: The synthezoid he wants to own
stages.whoB: The man who put a price on him

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: The Client calls Jocasta his beautiful queen and offers her a way to become Josephine Carrington again. When her crypt will not open without a sixth key, he captures her.
stages.whoA: The synth he lures and captures
stages.whoB: The man who lures and captures her

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Jo Carrington and her partner share a Stark Award for their work on A.I. She refuses to sell to Stark and tells him they should use her nanotech themselves, as loving gods.
stages.whoA: His partner in science and in life
stages.whoB: Her partner, who shares her plan

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Paladin hunts Vision from Edinburgh to Saint Mabyn's, wounding him with adamantium rounds, and later uses Thomas as bait in Madripoor. After they fight the Ten Rings together, Paladin powers Vision's dive into his code and delivers him to the Client.
stages.whoA: The synthezoid he is paid to catch
stages.whoB: The bounty hunter who hunts him

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Paladin kidnaps Thomas Shepherd to lure Vision, and later holds him in Madripoor with an explosive strapped on. He tells Thomas about WandaVision, then helps him get the dying Lisa to safety.
stages.whoA: The boy he kidnaps twice as bait
stages.whoB: The bounty hunter who kidnaps him

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Paladin takes Thomas from Lisa at gunpoint and orders her to count to a hundred. Later Lisa helps hijack his van in Madripoor, and he takes her in when she falls ill.
stages.whoA: Thomas's friend, whom he robs of him
stages.whoB: The hunter who takes Thomas from her

stages.title: VisionQuest
