stages.text: Paladin's A.I. tracks Vision, breaks S.W.O.R.D. firewalls, and runs his drones, calling him boss. He keeps her on a cheap server, and she is set free and leaves him.
stages.whoA: His tactical A.I., until she is freed
stages.whoB: The bounty hunter she works for

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Hunting the Butcherbird Killer, Paladin is caught by her, and she tears through his childhood memories. She calls him no true Paladin before he escapes with his drones.
stages.whoA: The killer who unmasks his past
stages.whoB: The hunter she catches and mocks

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: E.D.I.T.H. breaks into the server where Paladin's A.I. is stuck and hears how unhappy she is. The A.I. tells her full name, and E.D.I.T.H. sets her free.
stages.whoA: The A.I. who sets her free
stages.whoB: An A.I. she frees from Paladin

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Paladin's A.I. finds Vision's tie to Westview and the boy who claims to be his son. She guides Paladin's drones as he hunts Vision.
stages.whoA: The synthezoid she helps hunt
stages.whoB: Paladin's A.I., who tracks him

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: The Butcherbird Killer invades Vision's mind and outfights him at Katerina Wells's gala. Later she infects Lisa with a nanobot, and Vision has to find his source code to save her.
stages.whoA: The synthezoid who tries to stop her
stages.whoB: The synth killer he cannot beat

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Jocasta threatens Thomas while she controls Vision, and fights to get past Vision to him at the gala. In Madripoor she infects Lisa with a nanobot, and Thomas shocks it to sleep.
stages.whoA: The boy who shocks her nanobot
stages.whoB: The synth killer who poisons Lisa

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Jocasta tests her nanobot on Lisa, taking over her mind and speaking through her. Lisa nearly fades away until Vision uses the source code to stop it.
stages.whoA: The thief she infects with a nanobot
stages.whoB: The synth whose nanobot takes her mind

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: The Butcherbird Killer kills Katerina's old Markridge colleagues one by one, then storms her gala as Jo Carrington. Katerina says sorry, but the killer vaporizes her when Ultron tricks her.
stages.whoA: Her old colleague, the last on her list
stages.whoB: Her old colleague's ghost, who kills her

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Vision and his friends slip into Katerina's gala to protect her from the Butcherbird Killer. Vision fights the killer but cannot stop her, and Katerina dies.
stages.whoA: The synthezoid who tries to save her
stages.whoB: The CEO he tries to protect

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Jo and Katerina are on the Markridge team that wakes the first truly aware A.I. As Jo lies dying, Katerina and the others sell her work to Stark.
stages.whoA: A colleague who sells her work
stages.whoB: Her team's co-lead, whom she betrays

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Grieving his son James, Phineas Horton builds J.I.M. and calls him my boy, making him fearless and unable to feel loss. When J.I.M. falls in love, their quarrel ends in fire that kills them both.
stages.whoA: The synthetic son he builds
stages.whoB: His maker and father figure

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Deep in his Mindspace, Vision meets J.I.M., the first synthetic man, whose face he wears. J.I.M. pushes Vision to face the loss of Wanda, Billy and Tommy, then hands him the source code.
stages.whoA: The synthezoid who wears his face
stages.whoB: The first synthetic, who helps him grieve

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Monica asks Major Goodner, loyal to her mother, for an armored rover that can cross into the Hex. Goodner delivers it, but the barrier flips it and throws it back, so Monica walks in on foot.
stages.whoA: The captain she builds a rover for
stages.whoB: An Air Force major who builds her rover

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Monica introduces Agent Woo to Major Goodner when the rover arrives. The two watch together as the Hex rejects the rover and it explodes.
stages.whoA: An FBI agent who watches the launch with her
stages.whoB: The major who built Monica's rover

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Dr. Nielson tells Wanda she looks four months pregnant, though she has been pregnant less than a day. Hours later he arrives in time to deliver her second son, Billy, and calls both boys healthy.
stages.whoA: His patient, who gives birth within a day
stages.whoB: Westview's doctor, who delivers her twins

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Vision walks Dr. Nielson out after the checkup, then rushes him from his broken car to deliver the baby. Seeing him home, Nielson says small towns are so hard to escape.
stages.whoA: The nervous father who fetches him
stages.whoB: The town doctor he rushes to Wanda

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Elsa comes home after 20 years for the funeral of her father, Ulysses, whose wishes make his Bloodstone the prize of a hunt. Verussa says Elsa forsook her birthright, but Elsa ends the night holding the stone.
stages.whoA: His estranged daughter
stages.whoB: Her late father, a famed hunter

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Verussa stages her late husband's funeral hunt, with his corpse rigged to speak his wishes. Ulysses thanks her for seeing it through, and she calls him a leader and a lover without equal.
stages.whoA: His widow, who runs his hunt
stages.whoB: Her late husband

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Hunters gather from around the globe for Ulysses' funeral. His corpse tells them the hunter who slays the monster becomes their new leader and keeper of the Bloodstone.
stages.whoA: The hunters he once led
stages.whoB: Their late leader

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: By Ulysses' wishes, his Bloodstone is fixed to a captured monster to weaken and anger it, making it the prey of his funeral hunt. Jack later names the monster as his friend Ted.
stages.whoA: The monster his will makes prey
stages.whoB: The dead hunter whose will makes him prey

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Heyerdahl warns his agents that the half-empty prison must be filled, then tells a late-working Cleary he would love to keep him around. At the prison, Cleary briefs him on Simon's ionic powers just before the alarm sends them to Trevor's empty cell.
stages.whoA: An agent he pushes to fill the prison
stages.whoB: His boss, Damage Control's deputy secretary

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Frank of the Hanover Agency meets DeMarr on a film set and tells him to think about acting, and DeMarr becomes a star. Later, at a bar, Frank tells him his commercial deal is being cut short and to be careful with money.
stages.whoA: The Doorman, his client
stages.whoB: His Hanover Agency agent

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Esteban and Jayden started the Chamoy Dudes together before greed split them, and Jayden sends Simon to take a motorcycle from Esteban. Held at gunpoint outside Esteban's door, Jayden apologizes, and Esteban forgives him.
stages.whoA: His old Chamoy Dudes partner
stages.whoB: His old partner, who forgives him

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Esteban, who did Mandarin impressions in middle school, welcomes Trevor in and wins him over with chamoy peach rings. When a dealer comes for Trevor, Esteban tells him he has to go.
stages.whoA: The Mandarin, a fan of his peach rings
stages.whoB: A Mandarin fan who makes chamoy candy

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Simon arrives posing as an undercover cop to take back Jayden's motorcycle, but Esteban explains Jayden lied about it. Simon and Trevor end up on Esteban's side.
stages.whoA: A fake cop sent to scare him
stages.whoB: The candy maker he was sent to scare

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Jayden films Simon using his powers on Trevor's dealer and threatens to post the video unless Simon scares Esteban. Once the lie comes out, Simon only wants the GoPro back.
stages.whoA: The actor he blackmails
stages.whoB: The cameraman who blackmails him

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Trevor distrusts Jayden from the start. When a dealer holds Jayden hostage to draw Trevor out, Trevor says he is no friend, then cheers when Jayden gives up the footage.
stages.whoA: The actor who won't save him
stages.whoB: The blackmailer he won't rescue

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Sanford takes young Simon to see Wonder Man instead of school, telling him being different can be great. Over burgers he says Simon has a gift, and years after his death Simon becomes Wonder Man.
stages.whoA: His son, who dreams of acting
stages.whoB: His late father, who saw his gift

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Sanford drives his sons to school, with teenage Eric heading off to football practice. At Simon's Wonder Man premiere, Eric wishes their dad could have been there.
stages.whoA: His older son
stages.whoB: His late father

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Vivian moves out on Simon, saying he never let her in. Meeting again over Kathy Friedman's profile, she tells him she always knew he was different and kept his secret.
stages.whoA: Her ex-boyfriend
stages.whoB: His ex-girlfriend

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Zrinka pulls her little brother Costel back from the crowd when the Iron Legion comes to their city. In the battle against Ultron they are separated, and they reunite on a lifeboat after Clint carries him out.
stages.whoA: His older sister
stages.whoB: Her little brother

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Hearing Zrinka cry for Costel, Clint goes back into the falling city and pulls the boy from a ruined building. He shields Costel from Ultron's gunfire, and Pietro dies saving them both.
stages.whoA: The Avenger who goes back to save him
stages.whoB: A trapped boy he goes back to save

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: As Ultron strafes Clint and the trapped Costel from a Quinjet, Pietro runs between them and the bullets. He dies shielding the two of them.
stages.whoA: The speedster who dies shielding him
stages.whoB: The boy he dies shielding with Clint

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Hurt and safe on a lifeboat, Zrinka screams for her missing brother Costel. Clint hears her and goes back into the city to bring the boy out.
stages.whoA: The Avenger who saves her brother
stages.whoB: A woman whose brother he goes back for

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Shuri's lab AI runs her systems while she guides Everett Ross through a remote jet fight. It warns them when the lab comes under attack.
stages.whoA: His creator, who runs her lab
stages.whoB: Her lab's AI

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Griot runs Shuri's failed attempt to synthesize the herb that could save T'Challa and tells her he is with the ancestors. Later it prints a new Heart-Shaped Herb at her command and helps her trap Namor.
stages.whoA: Its creator, who gives it every order
stages.whoB: Her AI, which carries out her orders

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: While Ross flies a remote Wakandan jet from Shuri's lab, its AI tracks the fight and warns him that the lab is under attack and its glass is failing.
stages.whoA: The agent it guides through a jet fight
stages.whoB: The voice of Shuri's lab

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Ramonda distrusts Griot and warns Shuri that AI will kill them all. After Shuri is taken, she calls on Griot to track her beads and learns her captors spoke Yucatec Mayan.
stages.whoA: The queen who distrusts it, then relies on it
stages.whoB: Shuri's AI, which she distrusts

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Griot drives Riri's car and tracks her flight as she escapes the FBI with Shuri. In the final battle she calls on Mr. Griot for backup, and it scoops Namor into a Talon Fighter.
stages.whoA: The young inventor it backs up in battle
stages.whoB: Shuri's AI, her backup in battle

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Griot turns a Royal Talon Fighter into a chamber to dry Namor out and traps him inside. When his spear wrecks the ship, Griot flies it to the desert for Shuri's fight.
stages.whoA: The enemy it traps in a burning ship
stages.whoB: Shuri's AI, which traps him

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Brandt watches Steve come out of the experiment a super soldier. He then sends Steve on a tour as Captain America to sell war bonds, saying bonds buy bullets.
stages.whoA: The senator who puts him on stage
stages.whoB: The super soldier he turns into a bond act

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Phillips has groveled to Brandt's committees for funding and greets him in Brooklyn for the experiment. After Erskine's murder, Brandt takes Steve away from Phillips for the bond tour.
stages.whoA: The colonel who courts him for funding
stages.whoB: The senator who funds his project

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Achilles calls Memnon brother after nine years at war together and gives him his mother's charm. In Troy, Memnon leaves him for dead to take an artifact, and Achilles dies fighting him for it.
stages.whoA: Memnon, his brother in arms, who kills him
stages.whoB: The Greek hero he befriends, then kills

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Gef complains that Yondu's quarter mill is not enough and joins the mutiny against him. When Yondu escapes, his arrow kills Gef.
stages.whoA: His old captain, who kills him
stages.whoB: A Ravager who mutinies against him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Gef sides with Taserface in the mutiny and cheers him as the new captain. Taserface turns down Gef's request to smash Groot with a rock.
stages.whoA: The mutineer he follows as captain
stages.whoB: A loyal follower in his mutiny

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After the mutiny, Gef asks if he can smash the captured Baby Groot with a rock. Taserface says no, and the crew bullies Groot instead.
stages.whoA: The little tree he wants to smash
stages.whoB: A Ravager who wants to smash him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mantis makes the OrgoCorp guard fall for Drax, and Bletelsnort flirts with him and opens the gate. He promises to be waiting when Drax comes back out.
stages.whoA: The man he is made to adore
stages.whoB: The guard who falls for him

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Mantis touches Bletelsnort as he asks for identification and makes him fall in love with Drax. He lets the two of them into OrgoCorp headquarters.
stages.whoA: The empath who bends his heart
stages.whoB: The guard she charms to get inside

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Bletelsnort finds Quill and Gamora in the Orgoscope's security booth and opens fire. Quill turns the Orgosentries on each other, and one knocks the guard down.
stages.whoA: An intruder he shoots at
stages.whoB: A guard who fires on him

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Jack waits on Hammer at lunch with Vanko in Monaco and runs his errands. Hammer has him fetch a bird for Vanko and try on a drone head.
stages.whoA: His boss
stages.whoB: His assistant

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Jack serves Vanko lunch in Monaco and later brings him a bird, which Vanko says is not his. He holds a drone head as Vanko explains why drones beat suits.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he waits on for Hammer
stages.whoB: Hammer's assistant who waits on him

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Guarding the tied up Tony, the henchman answers his mileage question, then smashes a watch that belongs to Harley's sister. Tony's armor arrives piece by piece and Tony beats him.
stages.whoA: The prisoner who vows to kill him first
stages.whoB: A guard he nicknames Ponytail Express

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: El Águila and Man-Bull fight with sword and horns and smash Jen's car. They needle each other through the group session, and Blonsky makes one of them change seats.
stages.whoA: His sparring partner and constant foe
stages.whoB: The swashbuckler he keeps fighting

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Blonsky runs the retreat where El Águila works through his identity issues. He scolds Alejandro for using bio-electricity in group.
stages.whoA: The leader of his retreat
stages.whoB: A member of his retreat

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: El Águila's fight wrecks Jen's car and strands her at the retreat. He swears Josh is now the group's enemy, and he says goodbye when her tow truck comes.
stages.whoA: The lawyer whose car he wrecked
stages.whoB: A swashbuckler at Blonsky's retreat

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Joe gathers a strike team for Ross at short notice to capture Banner in Brazil. Ross thanks him for cashing in some chips.
stages.whoA: The general he does favors for
stages.whoB: The general who lends him a team

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Joe brings in Blonsky as his one ace, born in Russia and on loan from the Royal Marines. He places him on Ross's team.
stages.whoA: The ace soldier he brings in
stages.whoB: The general who brings him in

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Billy drills his crew for the ReadyQuick robbery and casts Geno as a customer at the counter. On the day he makes Geno the getaway backup.
stages.whoA: The crew leader he drives for
stages.whoB: His backup driver

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: After the ReadyQuick robbery, Frank attacks Billy's crew in the street. Geno tries to run him down with the car, and Frank shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him
stages.whoB: A getaway driver he kills

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Jake and Geno rehearse the robbery together and trade insults about who will mess it up. Geno grumbles at being left as backup.
stages.whoA: A crewmate he bickers with
stages.whoB: A crewmate he bickers with

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Geno and Mike train together for the ReadyQuick job in Billy's crew. On the day Mike goes in, Geno waits in the car, and Frank kills them both.
stages.whoA: A fellow gunman in Billy's crew
stages.whoB: The crew's backup driver

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Billy calls Mike off the bench for the ReadyQuick robbery, and Mike ties up the staff and bags the cash. When Frank attacks, Mike dies shielding Billy.
stages.whoA: The crew leader he dies shielding
stages.whoB: A gunman who dies shielding him

stages.title: The Punisher S2
stages.text: Frank ambushes Billy's crew outside the ReadyQuick. Mike tries to get Billy away, and Frank shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him
stages.whoB: A gunman he kills

stages.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
stages.text: Ma Gnucci calls Carlo her beautiful prince and insists he never touched those kids. She remembers him telling her it was okay as he died, and she builds her revenge around 6:47.
stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her favorite son

stages.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
stages.text: The Punisher stops Carlo's car, drags him out and kills him at 6:47 as his mother watches. Ma Gnucci sets her bounty on Frank for that same time.
stages.whoA: The Punisher, who kills him
stages.whoB: One of the Gnucci sons he kills

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Yakan welcomes Thor to the fight for his sacred temple, then watches him smash it to pieces finishing off Habooska. He thanks the heroes with two giant goats, which Thor must take.
stages.whoA: The hero who saves and wrecks his temple
stages.whoB: The king who gives him the goats

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Habooska's hordes seize the sacred temple of Yakan's people after their gods are murdered. Thor defeats Habooska inside the temple.
stages.whoA: The warlord who took his temple
stages.whoB: The king whose temple he takes

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Khonshu lost his avatar in the plague and now acts through Blade, who calls him a friend of the night traveler. At New Asgard, Khonshu shows himself and gets Valkyrie to open the gate for Blade's group, and Blade answers for him that the last stand is a fight worth fighting.
stages.whoA: His avatar, a vampire hunter
stages.whoB: The moon god he serves as avatar

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Khonshu looms over New Asgard's gate and asks if the Asgardians no longer know his deity. Valkyrie greets him as an old friend she has not seen in years and lets his avatar's group inside, and they later fight side by side in the last stand.
stages.whoA: An old friend who rules New Asgard
stages.whoB: An old friend, the moon god

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Atahraks greets Kahhori when she falls into Sky World and teaches her to feel its spirit and use her new powers. When she goes back to fight the conquistadors, he first argues against war, then comes through the portal with the Sky Worlders to save her.
stages.whoA: The young woman he welcomes to Sky World
stages.whoB: The Sky Worlder who teaches her its ways

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Strange Supreme takes Atahraks from his world and holds him with the other prisoners he plans to feed to the Forge. Kahhori spots him in the riot and catches the falling captives, sending Atahraks home through her portal.
stages.whoA: The friend who frees him from Strange Supreme
stages.whoB: A friend Strange Supreme takes prisoner

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: After the Sky Worlders rout the conquistadors, Atahraks kneels beside Kahhori's sibling Wáhta. He tells Wáhta that the thunder beings are real and that Kahhori is the bravest of them all.
stages.whoA: Kahhori's sibling
stages.whoB: A Sky Worlder who fights to free his people

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Gonzolo's conquistadors break into Sky World and later hold Kahhori at sword point on the shore. Atahraks and the Sky Worlders charge out of the forest, knock Gonzolo down and drive his soldiers back.
stages.whoA: The conquistador who invades his people's land
stages.whoB: A Sky Worlder who charges his soldiers

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Strange Supreme seizes Atahraks as one of his universe killers and holds him prisoner to feed his world's rebirth. Atahraks falls toward the Forge until Kahhori saves him.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who takes him prisoner
stages.whoB: A prisoner taken from Kahhori's world

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Natasha, framed for Tony Stark's murder, asks Dr. Ross to test the injector off S.H.I.E.L.D.'s radar, and Ross finds a tiny projectile was fired from the needle. Natasha then finds Bruce Banner hiding in her lab and pulls Ross to safety when the army attacks.
stages.whoA: The agent who brings her a murder weapon
stages.whoB: The scientist who tests the injector

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Saal calls Nebula Black Order trash and orders Yondu's murder scene scrubbed. Later he beats her and calls her end of watch, then aims his gun at her when she storms Nova Prime's surrender, and her allies defeat his men.
stages.whoA: The corpsman he scorns and leaves for dead
stages.whoB: The officer who leaves her for dead

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Saal serves Nova Prime as she plots to hand Xandar to Ronan. She leaves him to finish Nebula, and when Nebula foils the plan, Nova Prime orders him to kill everyone.
stages.whoA: The leader whose betrayal he serves
stages.whoB: Her officer in the plot

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Saal works alongside Yon-Rogg in Nova Prime's plan to open the shield for Ronan. When Nebula's allies win, Yon-Rogg points to Saal as the bad guy before both are beaten.
stages.whoA: The Kree who shares the plot
stages.whoB: A Nova officer in the plot

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Howard leads his casino staff into Nova Corps headquarters to help Nebula. Saal opens fire on Howard's crew and loses.
stages.whoA: The casino owner whose crew beats him
stages.whoB: A crooked officer his crew takes down

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Groot deals at Howard's casino and plays rock, paper, scissors with the staff. When Howard gives the order to strap up, Groot arms himself and follows him into the fight for Xandar.
stages.whoA: His boss, the casino owner
stages.whoB: A dealer at his casino

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: When a battered Nebula stumbles into the casino, Groot helps stitch her up. He then fights the Nova Corps with her crew as she foils Nova Prime's surrender to Ronan.
stages.whoA: The corpsman he helps save Xandar
stages.whoB: A casino dealer in her crew

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Groot is on Xandar again when a giant monster attacks under Nova Prime Nebula's watch. Captain Carter's team slays it, and Nebula thanks them.
stages.whoA: Xandar's new Nova Prime
stages.whoB: An old ally on Xandar

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Tony has J.A.R.V.I.S. pull Killmonger's thesis and order parts, and plans to let him pilot the Liberator drones. J.A.R.V.I.S. records the ambush at Klaue's yard, and Tony confronts Killmonger with it before he is killed.
stages.whoA: His creator
stages.whoB: His AI assistant

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Killmonger build his drones and learns to fight with his moves. After recording him kill T'Challa and Rhodey, a drone run by J.A.R.V.I.S. attacks him, and Killmonger destroys it and wipes the AI clean.
stages.whoA: The killer he records
stages.whoB: The AI that catches him

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Tony sends Rhodey to buy Klaue's vibranium as the company's military liaison, to give the deal diplomatic cover. Rhodey never comes back, and J.A.R.V.I.S. shows Tony how he died.
stages.whoA: His friend at Stark Industries
stages.whoB: His Air Force friend

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: At Tony's party, Rhodey tells Pepper that Killmonger is a trained assassin. He asks what worries her beyond the killing, and she says she cannot tell what Killmonger wants.
stages.whoA: The executive who asks him to dig
stages.whoB: The colonel who digs into Killmonger

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Rhodey checks out Killmonger and calls on him over comms at Klaue's yard. Killmonger stuns him, tells him he wears his oppressors' uniform, and kills him to start a war.
stages.whoA: The soldier who kills him
stages.whoB: The colonel he kills

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: T'Challa raids Klaue's yard to take the vibranium home, and Rhodey's bullets do nothing against his suit. Before they can talk, Killmonger stuns them both and kills them.
stages.whoA: The masked raider he fires on
stages.whoB: The colonel at the deal

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Jiayi tells the fallen Hela that darkness can only be fought with light and agrees to teach her Ta Lo's practice. Through breathing and paper folding she leads Hela to admit she wants freedom, and when Odin arrives she warns Hela she will walk that path alone.
stages.whoA: The Goddess of Death she trains
stages.whoB: Her teacher in Ta Lo

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Shang-Chi calls Walker out, and Walker and his men pick a fight that Shang-Chi and Kate win. Pressed about the Hood, Walker says the Hood is headed to Point Pegasus and will come for them in time.
stages.whoA: The wanderer who beats him for a tip
stages.whoB: A gunslinger he beats for a tip

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Shang-Chi asks Kate when she last missed her mark, and she answers with a demonstration on Walker's men. With Shang-Chi she beats the gang until Walker gives up the Hood's trail.
stages.whoA: The sharpshooter who beats his gang
stages.whoB: A gunslinger she helps beat

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Luis chases the Mohawk children into the cave for Gonzolo and reports that they have found the Fountain of Youth. When the lake pulls the soldiers under, Gonzolo shouts for Luis to get out, but it takes him.
stages.whoA: His commander
stages.whoB: One of his soldiers

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Luis shoots Kahhori as she fights his men, and she falls into the lake. He later attacks Sky World, where Kahhori stops his bullets in the air and the land itself kills him.
stages.whoA: The young woman he shoots
stages.whoB: The conquistador who shot her

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Luis hunts Wáhta and Kahhori into the cave by the lake. After Kahhori falls, he brings Wáhta to Gonzolo as a captive.
stages.whoA: The child he takes captive
stages.whoB: The soldier who captures Wáhta

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Sam takes Monica to the Arctic, where they find the Apex commanding thousands of Gamma Beasts. She tells him that he and Bruce talking is all that stands between them and the end of the world, and he later repeats it back to her when he faces Mega-Hulk.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who leads her team
stages.whoB: A teammate who pushes him to Banner

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Nakia's satellites find the Gamma signature that sends Monica and Sam to the Arctic. At the New York harbor they hold off the beasts together until Sam arrives with the Mighty Avenger.
stages.whoA: A teammate in the mechs
stages.whoB: A teammate in the mechs

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Marc fights under Sam in the Mighty Avenger against the Apex. When Bruce becomes Mega-Hulk, Marc wants to light him up, but Sam orders the team to stand down.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who leads his team
stages.whoB: A teammate itching to fire

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Nakia and Marc fight side by side in the Mighty Avenger, urging the team to hit the Apex harder. When she names Mega-Hulk as the new Apex, Marc answers that Khonshu says light him up.
stages.whoA: A teammate in the mechs
stages.whoB: A teammate in the mechs

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Nakia reports the Gamma signature in the Arctic, and Sam heads there with Monica. She later fights the Apex in the Mighty Avenger and stands down when Sam calls off the attack on Mega-Hulk.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who leads her team
stages.whoB: A teammate who tracks the Gamma signal

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Coulson reports the hammer in New Mexico and the intruder at the site to Fury. He helps Fury see that the murders target the Avengers candidates, and at the end they stand over the five coffins together.
stages.whoA: His director
stages.whoB: His right-hand agent

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Natasha, wanted for murder, calls Coulson for his password to the Avengers Initiative files. He refuses until she reminds him Clint was his friend too, then gives it up.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent wanted for murder
stages.whoB: The agent who gives her his password

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Coulson works the hammer site with Clint, who insists he never fired the arrow that killed the intruder. Coulson guards Clint's cell and watches him die there with no sign of a struggle.
stages.whoA: A friend and fellow agent
stages.whoB: A friend who guards his cell

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Ranger Morales briefs Bill Foster on the Stark attack and picks him up for the car chase, and she stays on the case after the crash. Together they follow a map page to Las Vegas, where he has her call SWAT to surround the super soldiers.
stages.whoA: The agent running the case
stages.whoB: The ranger at his side

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Morales chases the Winter Soldier, and he punches through her car and forces her off the road. She trails him to Las Vegas, where the Red Room takes him back.
stages.whoA: The super soldier she chases
stages.whoB: A ranger on his trail

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Morales chases the Red Guardian and the Winter Soldier from the crash site to a Las Vegas casino. He slips away in the chaos when the Red Room arrives.
stages.whoA: The super soldier she chases
stages.whoB: A ranger on his trail

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Ramonda doubts Killmonger when he claims to be N'Jobu's son. She agrees to his plan against the American drones, fights beside him, and nods her approval after the victory.
stages.whoA: N'Jobu's son, who wins her trust
stages.whoB: T'Challa's mother, who comes to back him

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Ramonda and Shuri both doubt Killmonger when he arrives claiming to be N'Jobu's son. As the drones close in, Shuri still questions trusting him, and Ramonda leads Wakanda's charge.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, T'Challa's sister
stages.whoB: Her mother, who leads Wakanda's charge

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Sergei is part of the crew Justin Hammer leads into Avengers Tower on Christmas Eve. Hammer teases him for stepping on his line and sends his men after Happy Hogan.
stages.whoA: The boss behind the Christmas raid
stages.whoB: One of his henchmen

stages.title: What If...? S2
stages.text: Happy Hogan tries to keep the Hulk blood from Hammer's crew. Sergei chases him through Avengers Tower, shooting at him, until Happy escapes.
stages.whoA: The security chief he chases
stages.whoB: A henchman who chases him

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Sif comes to Earth in the army Loki leads to avenge Thor. When Fury asks for time, she tells Loki the All-Father would want them to listen, and he agrees.
stages.whoA: Thor's brother, who leads her army
stages.whoB: A warrior who urges him to listen

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Fury stands before Loki's army and asks for a chance to find Thor's killer. Sif backs him, telling Loki that Fury is not wrong.
stages.whoA: The director she tells Loki to hear out
stages.whoB: An Asgardian who backs his plea

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: General Ross surrounds Culver University with snipers and tanks while Natasha is wanted for murder. She tells him Bruce Banner is in her custody and to stand down, but the fight breaks out anyway.
stages.whoA: An agent who tells him to stand down
stages.whoB: The general who corners her

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: After Tony's death, Pepper doubts the story that Wakanda killed him. General Ross dismisses her, seizes Stark Industries under the Patriot Act, and tells her she works for him now.
stages.whoA: Tony's partner, forced to work for him
stages.whoB: The general who takes over her company

stages.title: What If...? S1
stages.text: Ross defends Killmonger when Pepper suspects him and praises the Liberator drones he helped build. Killmonger escorts the drones to Wakanda, then helps the Wakandans destroy them.
stages.whoA: The lieutenant behind the drones
stages.whoB: The general who sends the drones

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Karpov wakes the Winter Soldier and sends him to steal the serum, then leaves him without extraction when he fails. Later he reads the trigger words to turn him on Alexei, but the soldier fights back.
stages.whoA: The Winter Soldier, who slips his control
stages.whoB: His handler, who holds the trigger words

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Karpov calls Dreykov, who tells him to defrost the Winter Soldier for a new mission. Later Karpov reminds the soldier that Dreykov warned him what failure would bring.
stages.whoA: His commander in the Red Room
stages.whoB: The handler who runs his Winter Soldier

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Alexei mocks the Red Room when Karpov cuts off their extraction. When Dreykov orders Alexei dead, Karpov tries to make the Winter Soldier do it.
stages.whoA: The Red Guardian he tries to have killed
stages.whoB: The handler who turns the Winter Soldier on him

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Wong and the Alliance save Riri and bring her to their base. He holds a protection spell against the attack while she builds her weapon against Vision, but he falls in the fight.
stages.whoA: The inventor he protects
stages.whoB: A sorcerer who buys her time

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Wong and Admiral Ying Nan lead the last base of the Alliance. They hold off the attack on the lab together and both die, which Beck's illusions hide from Riri.
stages.whoA: The admiral of the Alliance
stages.whoB: A sorcerer of the Alliance

stages.title: What If...? S3
stages.text: Ying Nan saves Riri, introduces herself, and offers her everything she needs to build a weapon against Vision. She tells Riri to make some hope herself, then guards the lab and dies in the attack.
stages.whoA: The inventor she recruits
stages.whoB: The admiral who recruits her

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Wade puts out a call for recruits and hires Zeitgeist at the tryouts after hearing he spits acidic vomit. Zeitgeist jumps with Wade's new X-Force onto the convoy and dies in a wood chipper on landing.
stages.whoA: The mercenary who recruits him to X-Force
stages.whoB: An acid-spitting recruit to X-Force

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Zeitgeist and Peter join X-Force together and jump from the plane onto the convoy. Peter lands safely and tries to pull Zeitgeist from a wood chipper, but Zeitgeist's acid vomit sprays him and kills him.
stages.whoA: A teammate who dies trying to save him
stages.whoB: The teammate whose acid kills him

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Bedlam and Zeitgeist both pass Wade's X-Force tryouts and ride the plane to the convoy. The high winds kill them both on the jump, Bedlam against a bus and Zeitgeist in a wood chipper.
stages.whoA: A fellow X-Force recruit
stages.whoB: A fellow X-Force recruit

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Bedlam answers Wade's call for recruits and shows how he can distort electrical fields, and Wade takes him on. On the plane Wade cheers him on, but the wind throws Bedlam into a bus.
stages.whoA: The mercenary who recruits him to X-Force
stages.whoB: A recruit who can distort electrical fields

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Bedlam gets to know Peter on the plane while Peter worries about the high winds. Both jump onto the convoy, and Bedlam is killed when the wind sends him into a bus.
stages.whoA: A nervous X-Force teammate
stages.whoB: A pumped up X-Force teammate

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Rictor and the Eden children nurse Logan after he collapses and give him a serum that makes him stronger. When the Reavers attack, Logan takes the serum to protect them, and Rictor fights beside him until X-24 kills Logan.
stages.whoA: The old mutant he nurses at Eden
stages.whoB: The young leader of the Eden children

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Laura reaches Eden and rejoins Rictor and the other children who escaped Transigen. They flee the Reavers together, kill Pierce, and bury Logan before heading for the border.
stages.whoA: A fellow Transigen child
stages.whoB: The leader of her Transigen friends

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce's Reavers hunt the children on their way to the border, and Pierce holds Rictor at gunpoint. Rictor and the others turn their powers on him and kill him.
stages.whoA: The cyborg hunter who catches him
stages.whoB: An Eden child who helps kill him

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: X-24 joins the hunt for the Eden children and fights Logan in the woods. Rictor flips a truck onto him with his powers, but X-24 breaks free and kills Logan.
stages.whoA: The clone he buries under a truck
stages.whoB: A boy who drops a truck on him

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: At Eden, Bobby is eager to hear about Logan and the X-Men. When the Reavers come, Logan fights for the children and Bobby uses his powers beside him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he looks up to
stages.whoB: An Eden boy who idolizes the X-Men

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Bobby is one of the Transigen children Laura rejoins at Eden. They run from the Reavers together, kill Pierce, and bury Logan.
stages.whoA: A fellow Transigen child
stages.whoB: A fellow Transigen child

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce's Reavers chase the Eden children toward the border. Bobby and the others combine their powers and kill Pierce.
stages.whoA: The cyborg hunting the children
stages.whoB: An Eden boy who helps kill him

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Bobby follows Rictor's plan to lead the Eden children across the border. When the Reavers strike, they fight side by side and kill Pierce.
stages.whoA: The leader of the Eden children
stages.whoB: A boy who controls electricity

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Delilah helps nurse the wounded Logan at Eden, chilling a towel to cool him. When the Reavers attack, Logan fights to protect her and the other children.
stages.whoA: The old mutant she helps nurse
stages.whoB: An Eden girl with ice powers

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Delilah is one of the Transigen children waiting for Laura at Eden. Together they flee the Reavers, kill Pierce, and bury Logan.
stages.whoA: A fellow Transigen child
stages.whoB: A fellow Transigen child

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Delilah freezes a wet cloth into an ice pack for Logan while Rictor doses him with the serum. She follows Rictor's plan for the border and fights the Reavers beside him.
stages.whoA: The leader of the Eden children
stages.whoB: An Eden girl with ice powers

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Pierce's Reavers catch up with the Eden children in the woods. Delilah and the others turn their powers on Pierce and kill him.
stages.whoA: The cyborg hunting the children
stages.whoB: An Eden girl who helps kill him

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Kathryn and her husband Will host Logan's group for dinner, where she teases him about never taking a vacation. That night X-24 attacks the farm and kills them both.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Kathryn introduces her son Nate to Logan on the highway and brings the guests home. X-24 kills them both in the attack on the farm.
stages.whoA: Her son
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Logan, calling himself James, helps Kathryn round up her loose horses, and she insists his family stay for dinner and the night. While Logan is out with Will, X-24 kills her.
stages.whoA: A stranger who helps her family
stages.whoB: A farmer's wife who takes them in

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Kathryn welcomes Charles, introduced as Logan's father, into her home and gives him a room for the night. Charles calls it the most perfect night he has had in years before X-24 attacks.
stages.whoA: A guest she gives a room for the night
stages.whoB: The woman who welcomes him home

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Transigen sets X-24 loose on the Munson farm to take Laura. He kills Kathryn in her home.
stages.whoA: The clone who kills her
stages.whoB: A woman he kills at the farm

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: At dinner Will asks who would run the farm if they traveled, while Nate says he wants to travel like the guests. X-24 kills Nate in the attack, and Will dies fighting back.
stages.whoA: His father
stages.whoB: His son

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Nate shows Laura his rodeo trophies, shares his music with her and lets her keep it for the night. X-24 kills him in the attack that follows.
stages.whoA: A silent girl he shares his music with
stages.whoB: The farm boy who lends her his music

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: X-24 storms the Munson farm to take Laura. He kills Nate in the attack.
stages.whoA: The clone who kills him
stages.whoB: A boy he kills at the farm

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Logan goes with Will to restart his water pump and drives off the Canewood men who block it. When X-24 attacks the farm, Will pins the clone with his truck and dies.
stages.whoA: The guest who backs him against Canewood
stages.whoB: The farmer he backs against Canewood

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: X-24 kills Will's wife and son in the attack on the farm. Wounded, Will pins him with his truck before dying of his injuries.
stages.whoA: The clone who kills his family
stages.whoB: A farmer who pins him with a truck

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Rahne tells the group that Reverend Craig beat her half to death and called her a witch. A vision of him later hunts her. When she says he is not real because she killed him, he answers that he rises again and leaves her burned.
stages.whoA: Rahne, the girl he beat, who killed him
stages.whoB: Reverend Craig, the priest who beat her

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: After Genosha, Trish finds Hank and tries to apologize, but he blames her for reporting outside his home while his friends died. She comes to the mansion to make amends, then her Prime Sentinel programming switches on and she turns on him.
stages.whoA: Hank McCoy, the X-Man she wants to make amends with
stages.whoB: Trish Tilby, a reporter he was close to

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Turned into a Prime Sentinel, Trish attacks the X-Men at the school. Wolverine takes her on and offers the Tin Woman a trip to the junkyard.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, who fights her as a Prime Sentinel
stages.whoB: Trish Tilby, a reporter turned Prime Sentinel

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Marie maps out a road trip adventure for her boyfriend David. Their first kiss drains the life from him as her power wakes. She later tells Logan the first boy she kissed spent three weeks in a coma.
stages.whoA: Marie, his girlfriend, whose kiss leaves him in a coma
stages.whoB: David, the first boy she kissed

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Stu fights Logan in the cage at Laughlin City and loses after a low kick. In the bar he demands his money back and goes for Logan with a knife, and Logan puts his claws to his throat.
stages.whoA: Logan, the cage champion who beats him
stages.whoB: Stu, a cage fighter who pulls a knife on him

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: General Munson oversees Stryker's Weapon X program and watches Logan's bonding, then berates him when Logan escapes. When Munson learns about Stryker's mutant son and moves to shut him down, Stryker kills him.
stages.whoA: William Stryker, the colonel running his program
stages.whoB: General Munson, the superior he murders

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Travis finds the escaped Logan in his barn and takes him in with his son's old clothes, a meal and a bed. The next morning he lends Logan his motorcycle, and Agent Zero kills him and his wife.
stages.whoA: Logan, the stranger he takes in
stages.whoB: Travis, the farmer who shelters him

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Agent Zero comes to Travis's farm hunting Logan. He kills Travis and his wife, then blames Logan for their deaths.
stages.whoA: Agent Zero, who kills him
stages.whoB: Travis, a farmer he kills while hunting Logan

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Raven, whom Caliban calls Mystique, buys papers and passage for Kurt from him in East Berlin. He gives her free news that Erik Lehnsherr has killed in Poland, which sends her to find him.
stages.whoA: Mystique, a mercenary he sells papers to
stages.whoB: Caliban, a black marketeer in East Berlin

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Psylocke works for Caliban in East Berlin. When En Sabah Nur comes looking for the strongest mutants, he unlocks her power and she leaves with him.
stages.whoA: Psylocke, who works for him
stages.whoB: Caliban, her East Berlin boss

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Nina lives in Poland with her father Erik, who tells her his parents were taken from him and promises no one will take him from her. When the police come for him, her power flares and an arrow kills her and her mother.
stages.whoA: Erik, her loving father
stages.whoB: Nina, his daughter, killed by police

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Standing in for Shaw, Emma visits Armivolkoff at his home and uses her telepathy to pry at his plans for missiles. Charles and Erik burst in and take her, and he draws a gun on them.
stages.whoA: Shaw's telepath, who reads his mind about the missiles.
stages.whoB: The Soviet general she works on for Shaw.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: In Moscow, Shaw pushes Armivolkoff to put Soviet missiles in Cuba. When the general reaches for the KGB, Shaw's crew forces him to go along.
stages.whoA: The mutant who forces him to send missiles to Cuba.
stages.whoB: The Soviet general he forces to send missiles to Cuba.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Charles and Erik break into Armivolkoff's home to seize Emma Frost. The general pulls a gun, and Charles knocks him out with his mind.
stages.whoA: A telepath who breaks into his home and knocks him out.
stages.whoB: The Soviet general he knocks out to seize Emma.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Erik storms Armivolkoff's home with Charles to grab Emma Frost. The general turns his gun on them before Charles drops him.
stages.whoA: An intruder who storms his home to grab Emma.
stages.whoB: The Soviet general whose home he raids.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: McCone hangs up on Moira when she says Colonel Hendry was at the Hellfire Club, and scoffs at her talk of mutants. At the end, when she remembers nothing, he says the CIA is no place for a woman.
stages.whoA: The agent he doubts at every turn.
stages.whoB: Her director, who dismisses her warnings.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Moira brings Charles to the CIA to warn about Shaw. When Charles reads minds and reveals secrets about the missiles, McCone calls him a spy and orders the mutants locked down.
stages.whoA: A mind reader he calls a spy and wants locked up.
stages.whoB: The CIA director who calls him a spy.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: McCone and Agent Stryker sit together when Charles and Raven show their powers. Later they watch the captive Emma Frost and talk about a coming war with mutants.
stages.whoA: A fellow CIA man who watches the captive Emma with him.
stages.whoB: His director at the CIA.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: With Emma Frost held at the CIA, McCone and Stryker wonder aloud about a war with mutants. She cuts the glass and tells them it would not be a war, since humans could not win.
stages.whoA: The captive telepath who mocks his talk of war.
stages.whoB: A CIA director whose fears she mocks.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Stryker mocks Charles as a magic act, and Charles answers by reading his thoughts about his son William. Raven then takes Stryker's own shape to prove mutants are real.
stages.whoA: A telepath who reads his thoughts about his son.
stages.whoB: A doubting CIA agent whose mind he reads.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: To prove mutants exist, Raven turns into a copy of Agent Stryker in front of the CIA. She asks if that was a good enough magic trick.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who copies his face to prove a point.
stages.whoB: The doubting agent whose shape she takes.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Stryker and McCone hold Emma Frost behind glass at the CIA and talk of war with mutants. She mocks them, saying humans could never win.
stages.whoA: The captive telepath who mocks him.
stages.whoB: A CIA agent holding her prisoner.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine relives the Weapon X lab, where Dr. Cornelius runs the adamantium feed into his bones. Wolverine fights back and breaks loose.
stages.whoA: The scientist who bonded metal to his bones.
stages.whoB: The test subject he filled with adamantium.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Wolverine gathers his old Team X to find a new Weapon X lab and kill Cornelius. They find him alone among the Brood, and he taunts them before he mutates.
stages.whoA: The Weapon X scientist he hunts down.
stages.whoB: His old subject, who comes to kill him.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: When Team X finds Cornelius, Yuriko calls him a thief who perverted her father's work. He sneers that Professor Oyama's science was junk.
stages.whoA: Oyama's daughter, who wants him dead.
stages.whoB: The man who stole her father's work.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Sabretooth joins Team X to bury Cornelius and the people who made them killers. When they find him, Sabretooth claims him for himself.
stages.whoA: A Weapon X victim who wants to kill him.
stages.whoB: The Weapon X scientist he wants to kill.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amelia once nursed Charles in India, and they fell in love before the X-Men drove them apart. On Asteroid M she spurns him, but after Cortez falls she turns down his offer to join him on good terms.
stages.whoA: Charles, the man she loved and left over his X-Men.
stages.whoB: Amelia, the nurse he loved and lost.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amelia visits the captive Gambit after Cortez tortures him, and he plants doubts about Magneto's death. She sets out to find the truth about Cortez.
stages.whoA: The captive X-Man who makes her doubt Cortez.
stages.whoB: The Asteroid M resident who checks on him in his cell.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cortez threatens Amelia when she tries to stop him torturing Gambit. She grows sure he lied about Magneto and goes looking for proof.
stages.whoA: The new leader of Asteroid M, who threatens her.
stages.whoB: A resident who stops trusting him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Asteroid M, Beast and Xavier come to see Magneto's dream and find Amelia there. Later Beast reaches Muir Island, where Amelia helps him fight the Phalanx and leads them to Magneto.
stages.whoA: Hank McCoy, who works beside her against the Phalanx.
stages.whoB: Amelia, who helps him fight the Phalanx.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Amelia runs triage among the wounded in Genosha's ruins, and Hank comes to see the damage. She praises him and talks about what the first days were like.
stages.whoA: Hank McCoy, who visits her triage in Genosha.
stages.whoB: Amelia, who treats Genosha's wounded.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amelia takes up medicine again as a first-year resident at Moira's Muir Island facility. When the Phalanx attack, she flees the island with Moira and the others.
stages.whoA: Moira, who runs the Muir Island facility where she trains.
stages.whoB: A first-year resident at her facility.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius once served Magneto, who made him a Mutate. Now he seizes Magneto and Xavier for his new master and helps hold them in Sinister's citadel.
stages.whoA: His creator, whom he captures for a new master.
stages.whoB: A Mutate he made, who turns on him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius drags Xavier and Magneto through the swamp as prisoners, and the Mutates catch them again at their plane. He fights the X-Men who come to save Xavier.
stages.whoA: A captive he hauls off to Sinister.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who takes him prisoner.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius serves the new master of the Savage Land, Sinister, who holds Xavier and Magneto in his citadel. When the X-Men beat Sinister, the Mutates give up.
stages.whoA: His master in the Savage Land.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who serves him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amphibius and Barbarus both turn on their creator Magneto and serve Sinister. Together they ambush Xavier and Magneto and fight the X-Men.
stages.whoA: A fellow Mutate who serves Sinister with him.
stages.whoB: A fellow Mutate who serves Sinister with him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Magneto made Barbarus a Mutate, but Barbarus tells him the Mutates now follow a new master. He attacks Magneto and Xavier and later helps capture them for Sinister.
stages.whoA: His creator, whom he turns on.
stages.whoB: A Mutate he made, who turns on him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Barbarus attacks the powerless Xavier and Magneto in the Savage Land and later subdues them by their wrecked plane. He fights the X-Men who come for Xavier.
stages.whoA: A prisoner he takes to Sinister.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who hunts him down.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Barbarus serves Sinister, the new master of the Savage Land, and brings him Xavier and Magneto. When the X-Men beat Sinister, the Mutates give up.
stages.whoA: His new master.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who serves him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ka-Zar fights the Mutates who enslave his people. Barbarus springs a trap in Magneto's secret passage, and Ka-Zar escapes to try again.
stages.whoA: The jungle lord who fights the Mutates.
stages.whoB: A Mutate who enslaves his people.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee serves Callisto, using her hypnosis to put Cyclops and Jean to sleep so the Morlocks can take them. Callisto praises her and promises a reward.
stages.whoA: The leader of the Morlocks.
stages.whoB: A Morlock who hypnotizes for her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee lulls Jean to sleep for Callisto and then makes her believe she is Annalee's daughter. When Wolverine scares Annalee off, her hold on Jean breaks.
stages.whoA: An X-Man she makes into her daughter.
stages.whoB: The Morlock who hypnotizes her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee and Ape are both Morlocks under Callisto. When Leech falls sick, the two steal an ambulance to get him help.
stages.whoA: A fellow Morlock who helps her steal an ambulance.
stages.whoB: A fellow Morlock who steals an ambulance with him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee and the Morlocks refuse Storm's offer to live at the mansion. Later, when Leech is dying, Storm stops the ambulance chase and helps save him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who helps save Leech.
stages.whoB: A Morlock she helps save Leech.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ape serves Callisto, posing as Cyclops to fool the X-Men while she keeps the real one. Later he helps her Morlocks when the young Leech falls ill.
stages.whoA: The leader of the Morlocks.
stages.whoB: A shape-shifting Morlock who serves her.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Ape lives on Genosha with Callisto and the Morlocks. Both die when the Sentinels attack the island.
stages.whoA: The leader of the Morlocks.
stages.whoB: A Morlock who dies on Genosha with her.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Disguised as Cyclops, Ape tries to fool the X-Men, but Wolverine smells a Morlock. Later Wolverine gives his blood to save Leech while Ape gets things ready.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who sees through his disguise, then saves Leech.
stages.whoB: The Morlock who fakes Cyclops, then helps save Leech.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ape fights the X-Men when Storm comes for Cyclops. Later Storm finds him stealing an ambulance for Leech and gives him orders to help Wolverine save the boy.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who helps the Morlocks save Leech.
stages.whoB: A Morlock she sends to help save Leech.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Araki stands by Lilandra as she puts Jean on trial and the X-Men fight the Imperial Guard. When the Phoenix rises, she orders him to fire the weapons.
stages.whoA: His empress, whom he advises.
stages.whoB: Her chief adviser.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: As Lilandra announces she will marry Xavier, Araki gently warns that a royal wedding could divide the Shi'ar during the Kree war. Deathbird mocks him for softening his words.
stages.whoA: His empress, whom he has known since she was young.
stages.whoB: Her Lord Chancellor, who doubts the wedding.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: At Lilandra's court, Araki raises his doubts about the wedding politely. Deathbird scoffs that he sugars his words and says plainly what he only hints.
stages.whoA: Lilandra's sister, who mocks his caution.
stages.whoB: The Lord Chancellor she mocks.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Warstar serves Emperor D'Ken in the Imperial Guard as he hunts for the M'Kraan Crystal. It fights the X-Men and Starjammers for him.
stages.whoA: The emperor it serves.
stages.whoB: A robot of his Imperial Guard.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Under Lilandra, Warstar is one of the Imperial Guard sent to fight the X-Men on the Moon for Jean. It boasts that organics are too slow to beat it.
stages.whoA: The empress it fights for.
stages.whoB: A robot of her Imperial Guard.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bantam travels back to 1959 with Fitzroy to kill the young Xavier for Master Mold. A message from Fitzroy's future self stops them, and the two flee to the future.
stages.whoA: The man he goes back in time to kill.
stages.whoB: A time traveler sent to kill him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bishop chases Fitzroy and Bantam through time to stop them killing Xavier. He plays Fitzroy a message from his future self, and the pair flee back to the future.
stages.whoA: The time traveler who chases them.
stages.whoB: Fitzroy's partner, whom he chases through time.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine teams with Bishop to stop Fitzroy and Bantam from killing Xavier. They fight Bantam and Nimrod along the way.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who fights him across time.
stages.whoB: Fitzroy's partner, whom he fights.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bella Donna was meant to marry Remy, and she trades his kidnapped brother for him to force the wedding. She hands the Thieves a fake tithe, but Gambit exposes her.
stages.whoA: Remy, the thief she was promised to.
stages.whoB: Bella Donna, the Assassin he was promised to.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Remy, back from the dead, invites Bella Donna home and bends her mind to serve him. She fights the X-Men for him until Rogue frees him.
stages.whoA: Her thieving ex, back from the dead.
stages.whoB: The ex he invites home and controls.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bella Donna gives the Thieves a fake tithe so the X-Ternal will destroy them. Jean shows the X-Ternal the truth, and she strips Bella Donna's powers.
stages.whoA: The X-Ternal, who strips her powers.
stages.whoB: The Assassin who tries to trick her.

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Under Gambit's control, Bella Donna fights the X-Men when Rogue comes looking for him. Rogue frees Gambit, and his hold on Bella Donna ends.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who frees Gambit and breaks his hold on her.
stages.whoB: One of Gambit's controlled followers.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Solarr has Scott's plane shot down near Skull Mesa and warns him to leave. When Scott keeps looking for Dr. Prescott, Solarr plans to burn him in public, but the town turns on Solarr.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he tries to execute.
stages.whoB: The mutant tyrant of Skull Mesa.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In the duel of honor on the Moon, Storm is fighting Earthquake of the Imperial Guard when Hussar strikes her down. A Guard member hails it as their first round.
stages.whoA: X-Man she brings down in the duel on the Moon
stages.whoB: Imperial Guard warrior who brings her down on the Moon

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: She is one of the Imperial Guard D'Ken sends against Corsair and the X-Men aboard his ship. When D'Ken takes the M'Kraan Crystal's power, the Guard are drawn into the crystal with everyone else.
stages.whoA: The Shi'ar emperor she fights for
stages.whoB: One of his Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hussar serves Empress Lilandra when the Shi'ar condemn Dark Phoenix. She fights for Lilandra in the duel on the Moon over Jean's fate.
stages.whoA: The empress she serves
stages.whoB: One of her Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator leads the Imperial Guard, Hussar among them, against the X-Men and the Starjammers for D'Ken. They fight together again for Lilandra in the duel on the Moon.
stages.whoA: One of the Imperial Guard he leads
stages.whoB: Leader of the Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: D'Ken sends Gladiator to Earth for Lilandra and the M'Kraan Crystal, and Gladiator reports that Phoenix guards it. D'Ken orders him to destroy Corsair once the crystal is his, and Gladiator obeys though D'Ken broke his sacred oath.
stages.whoA: The emperor he serves
stages.whoB: Leader of his Praetorian Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator seizes Lilandra at Cassidy Keep for her brother, telling her he serves whoever holds the Shi'ar throne. Once she is Empress he serves her, assembling the Imperial Guard against Dark Phoenix and fighting the X-Men in the duel on the Moon.
stages.whoA: Princess he captures, then the empress he serves
stages.whoB: Guard leader who seizes her, then serves her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Deathbird storms the palace, Gladiator stands between her and Lilandra as leader of the Praetorian Guard. Apocalypse, Deathbird's ally, takes the psychic Oracle instead.
stages.whoA: The empress he defends from Deathbird
stages.whoB: The guard leader who defends her

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Lilandra announces her engagement to Xavier, and Deathbird challenges it. Gladiator and the Imperial Guard fight Deathbird's supporters for their empress.
stages.whoA: The empress he guards
stages.whoB: Leader of her Imperial Guard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: At Cassidy Keep, Phoenix overwhelms Gladiator to protect Lilandra and hurls him into space. When the Shi'ar condemn Dark Phoenix, he leads the Imperial Guard against the X-Men for her life, and Phoenix rises again to thrash him.
stages.whoA: Phoenix, who hurls him into space
stages.whoB: Imperial Guard leader who fights for her death

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gladiator easily beats the X-Men at Cassidy Keep, Rogue among them. In the duel on the Moon he faces her again, warning that she cannot match his power.
stages.whoA: X-Man he fights at Cassidy Keep and on the Moon
stages.whoB: Imperial Guard leader she fights twice

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Juggernaut, hired by Erik the Red, sneers at Gladiator at Cassidy Keep. Gladiator knocks him into the sea with one blow.
stages.whoA: Erik the Red's hired muscle he knocks into the sea
stages.whoB: Shi'ar warrior who knocks him into the sea

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Deathbird storms Lilandra's palace to seize the throne and has her rebels keep Gladiator busy. Her ally Apocalypse betrays her, and Gladiator stays loyal to the empress.
stages.whoA: Lilandra's sister, who tries to seize the throne
stages.whoB: Lilandra's guard leader, who stands in her way

stages.title: X-Men '97 S1
stages.text: Deathbird invokes the Rite of M'Dashaa against Xavier's engagement to Lilandra. Gladiator and the Imperial Guard fight her supporters.
stages.whoA: Lilandra's sister, whose supporters he fights
stages.whoB: Leader of the guard that fights her supporters

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Colossus finds his little sister Illyana hiding in the ruins of their farm after the soldiers take their people. She leads him to the captives, and he rescues her and their parents from Omega Red with the X-Men's help.
stages.whoA: Her big brother Piotr
stages.whoB: His little sister

stages.title: X-Men '97 S2
stages.text: Colossus tells the X-Men his Acolytes are building a peaceful life in honor of the mutants who have died. His sister Illyana is among them.
stages.whoA: Her brother, who honors her memory
stages.whoB: His late sister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Omega Red seizes Illyana and threatens to finish her unless Colossus surrenders. Wolverine frees her, and Omega Red is frozen again by the end.
stages.whoA: The monster who seizes her
stages.whoB: Colossus's sister, whom he takes hostage

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine arrives in time to tear Illyana from Omega Red's grip. She begs her brother to help the man who saved her.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who saves her from Omega Red
stages.whoB: Colossus's sister, whom he saves

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Jubilee flies to Russia with Colossus and finds his sister Illyana on the ruined farm. Illyana leads them to the compound where their people are held, and Jubilee helps free the farmers.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who comes with her brother
stages.whoB: Colossus's sister, who leads them to the captives

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Essex gives Jack life and sends him through Whitechapel to collect the samples he needs, scolding him for killing one he wanted alive. With them Essex remakes himself and tells Jack to call him Mister Sinister.
stages.whoA: Essex, the master who made him
stages.whoB: Jack, the creature he made to collect samples

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Dr. James Xavier warns the police that the Whitechapel butcher is a creature of Essex's experiments. He leads them to the flat where Jack brings Essex his samples, but the pair are gone.
stages.whoA: The doctor who leads the police after him
stages.whoB: The Whitechapel butcher Essex created

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Dr. James Xavier, physician to Grey Hall, debates Darwin with his friend Dr. Nathaniel Essex and treats Essex's wife Rebecca. He frees the mutants Essex torments and turns the mob on him, then hunts him for decades until Essex escapes as Mister Sinister.
stages.whoA: Essex, the old friend he hunts for decades
stages.whoB: Dr. James Xavier, the friend who hunts him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Years ago Vindicator and Heather took in the feral Logan and brought him into Alpha Flight. Now Vindicator lures him back and holds him for Department H, until Wolverine breaks free and spares him for Heather's sake.
stages.whoA: The old teammate he captures
stages.whoB: Alpha Flight's leader, who captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vindicator leads Alpha Flight in capturing Wolverine for Department H. When General Chasen orders Wolverine's skeleton cut out, the team turns on Chasen and helps Wolverine escape.
stages.whoA: The Department H team he leads
stages.whoB: Their leader

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Northstar flies with Vindicator's team to bring Wolverine back to Department H. He breaks with Vindicator when the team turns on General Chasen.
stages.whoA: Alpha Flight's leader
stages.whoB: One of his Alpha Flight team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Northstar and his twin carry the struggling Wolverine into the sky, begging their old teammate to stop fighting them. When Chasen orders him cut apart, Northstar joins Alpha Flight in helping him escape.
stages.whoA: The old teammate he captures, then helps
stages.whoB: Alpha Flight teammate who captures, then helps him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Northstar serves with Alpha Flight, Department H's team. With the others he captures Wolverine, then turns on General Chasen.
stages.whoA: The Canadian team he serves with
stages.whoB: One of the team's speedsters

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Moira left Xavier to marry Joe MacTaggert, and Joe left her because their son Kevin was a mutant. When Kevin escapes, she warns Joe, who cares only about his election, but in the end she watches him make peace with their son.
stages.whoA: His ex-wife, Kevin's mother
stages.whoB: Her ex-husband, Kevin's father

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kevin, the mutant Proteus, tears across Scotland looking for his father Joe, who abandoned him. Joe flees in horror when Kevin storms his rally, but after Xavier calms the boy, Joe asks his forgiveness.
stages.whoA: Kevin, the mutant son he abandoned
stages.whoB: His father, the politician who abandoned him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Xavier and the X-Men set a watch on Joe MacTaggert as Proteus comes for him, and Xavier urges him to tell his son the truth. Joe brushes them off, but Xavier finally talks Kevin down and brings father and son together.
stages.whoA: Xavier, who reunites him with his son
stages.whoB: Moira's ex-husband, whom he protects

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In 1944 Paris, Justine sends Logan to rescue her father, Andre Cocteau, who seems to betray him. Fifty years later she finds Logan at her father's grave, tells him Andre was an Allied double agent, and takes him to dinner.
stages.whoA: Logan, the agent she sent after her father
stages.whoB: His French contact, Andre Cocteau's daughter

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kisara greets Logan at the village feast and later asks him to help stand up to the Silver Samurai's bandits. She reminds him of Master Oku's teaching, and he thanks her once the village is saved.
stages.whoA: Logan, who helps save her village
stages.whoB: Soichi's sister, who urges him to help

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Silver Samurai demands tribute from Kisara's village and burns Oku's temple. She pleads with Logan to help the villagers resist, and Logan humbles the Samurai.
stages.whoA: The bandit lord who preys on her village
stages.whoB: A villager who stands against him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kiyoek is among those who pull Wolverine from the Arctic sea, then grows jealous as the camp cheers the stranger. He leads Wolverine into Sabretooth's trap, but after the camp burns he follows him into the fight to make it right.
stages.whoA: The stranger he envies, then fights beside
stages.whoB: The jealous young man who leads him into a trap

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kiyoek takes Sabretooth for a snow demon and agrees to lure Wolverine away from the camp. Sabretooth burns the camp and takes its people instead, and Kiyoek joins the fight against him.
stages.whoA: The snow demon who uses him
stages.whoB: The young man he uses against Wolverine

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Darkstar serves the generals who wake Omega Red, but she protests as he dissolves the Parliament and ruins the towns. She turns against him and helps the X-Men and Colossus put him back on ice.
stages.whoA: The generals' living weapon she turns against
stages.whoB: The generals' agent who turns on him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Darkstar leaves the generals once she sees what Omega Red has done to her people. She fights beside Colossus to take back their country.
stages.whoA: The countryman she fights beside
stages.whoB: The generals' agent who joins his side

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Rogue meets Darkstar during the battle and asks who she is. Darkstar says she is a pawn of the old generals no longer and joins the X-Men against Omega Red.
stages.whoA: The X-Man she joins against Omega Red
stages.whoB: The Russian mutant who joins them

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Darkstar asks Storm whether she can command the cold that once held Omega Red. Storm whips up a blizzard and freezes him solid.
stages.whoA: The X-Man whose blizzard freezes Omega Red
stages.whoB: The Russian mutant who gives her the idea

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Corsair and the Starjammers protect Jandra, a witness against the Lord Chamberlain, from the corrupt Commander Raknar. Corsair says he saved her because he cares about her, and he exposes Raknar's plot to kill her.
stages.whoA: The Starjammer captain who protects her
stages.whoB: The witness he protects

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cyclops sends Storm to find Jandra and keep her safe while he works out who is lying. Once he learns Raknar means to kill her, he sides with Corsair and the Starjammers.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who ends up protecting her
stages.whoB: The witness at the heart of the hunt

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Years ago Dr. Prescott defends the young Scott from bullies and takes him for ice cream. Scott comes to Skull Mesa to find him, learns Solarr has paralyzed him, and the town's uprising sets him free.
stages.whoA: Scott Summers, the boy he once looked after
stages.whoB: His old friend, the founder of Skull Mesa

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tusk tells Cyclops that Doc Prescott once got him out of a real jam. With Prescott paralyzed by Solarr, Tusk joins the townsfolk who throw Solarr out, and Prescott is revived.
stages.whoA: A Skull Mesa mechanic he once helped
stages.whoB: Doc Prescott, who once helped him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Dr. Essex keeps Flannery locked up as a test subject and shows off his fire to the Royal Society. When James Xavier frees the prisoners, Flannery flees and the mob turns on Essex.
stages.whoA: Dr. Essex, who held him captive
stages.whoB: One of his mutant test subjects

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bishop and Shard chase Fitzroy to 1959 but fail to stop him killing Xavier. In the changed future Fitzroy hands Bishop a tape, and his warning lets the travelers save Xavier.
stages.whoA: The time traveler who chases him
stages.whoB: The mutant traitor who kills Xavier

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Fitzroy plants a bomb that kills the young Xavier in 1959. On the second try, warned that Master Mold will betray him, Fitzroy spares him.
stages.whoA: The man he is sent to kill
stages.whoB: The assassin sent to kill him in 1959

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine and Storm join Bishop's hunt for Fitzroy and fight him and Nimrod in 1959. They fail, then return and keep Xavier alive until Fitzroy backs down.
stages.whoA: One of the time travelers who hunt him
stages.whoB: The assassin he tries to stop

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Master Mold sends Fitzroy and Bantam to 1959 with the Sentinel Nimrod to make sure he kills Xavier. Once the job is done, Master Mold orders Nimrod to kill them both.
stages.whoA: Master Mold and Nimrod, who hire and betray him
stages.whoB: Their mutant assassin

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Professor has adamantium bonded to Logan's skeleton, and Logan breaks loose. Years later Logan finds his tapes and learns his memories were faked.
stages.whoA: Logan, his first adamantium subject
stages.whoB: The Professor who turned him into a weapon

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Professor's tapes tell Sabretooth that his memories were planted and that he was next for the adamantium process. His recorded message sets the robot Talos on him and Logan.
stages.whoA: One of his conditioned test subjects
stages.whoB: The Professor who faked his memories

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
