stages.text: Cyclops asks Tusk for help against Solarr, but Tusk is afraid for his wife and children. When Solarr tries to make an example of Cyclops, Tusk joins the townsfolk who turn on him.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who asks him for help
stages.whoB: A Skull Mesa mechanic who finally stands up

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tyler cries out for his father as their future starts to vanish, and Cable finds him safe once the plague is stopped. Grown up, Tyler fights Apocalypse beside Cable and helps him steal a time machine, then stays behind.
stages.whoA: His father, Cable
stages.whoB: His son, Tyler

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tyler joins his father's attack on Apocalypse's pyramid in 3999. After Apocalypse steals Cable's time device, Tyler helps him go after him in the past.
stages.whoA: Apocalypse, the tyrant of his time
stages.whoB: One of Cable's fighters

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo brings the captive Xavier and Magneto to her master Sinister in the Savage Land. Later, in Sinister's crew, she helps kidnap Jean and fights for him at the Axis of Time.
stages.whoA: Sinister, her master
stages.whoB: One of his followers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In the Savage Land Vertigo overwhelms Xavier and Magneto and takes them to Sinister. She fights again when the X-Men break into Sinister's base.
stages.whoA: A captive she takes to Sinister
stages.whoB: A Savage Land mutant who captures him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo tries to force Wolverine to his knees in the Savage Land, but he gets away. She fights the X-Men again when Sinister's crew kidnaps Jean.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who escapes her power
stages.whoB: A mutant who makes his head spin

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vertigo is one of Sinister's crew who snatch Jean after her wedding. She turns her power on the X-Men when they come for Jean.
stages.whoA: The bride she helps kidnap
stages.whoB: One of her kidnappers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sasquatch helps Alpha Flight bring their old teammate Wolverine back to Department H. When General Chasen orders Wolverine's skeleton removed, Sasquatch and the team turn on the general.
stages.whoA: His old Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: An old Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wanda and Pietro lure Magneto into a trap to avenge their mother, until the High Evolutionary reveals that Magneto is their father. They fight together to escape, and Wanda leaves unsure if she can forgive him.
stages.whoA: Magneto, the father she never knew
stages.whoB: His daughter, the Scarlet Witch

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Warlock saves Beast from the Phalanx and asks for his help to find his Lifemate. Together they make a virus, and Warlock calls him Self-friend Hank before carrying it into the Phalanx core.
stages.whoA: Self-friend Hank, who helps him
stages.whoB: A Phalanx rebel he befriends

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Forge works with Warlock and Beast against the Phalanx. At the end Warlock asks Self-friends Hank and Forge to help him build a ship home.
stages.whoA: A Self-friend who helps him
stages.whoB: An alien ally against the Phalanx

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Warlock flees the Phalanx rather than merge with it, and it follows him to Earth and takes his Lifemate. He lets the Phalanx take him so the virus reaches its core.
stages.whoA: The hive mind he fled
stages.whoB: Its runaway heir

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Solarr's order Watchdog brings down Cyclops' plane, cuts off his powers and jams his signal. When the town turns on Solarr, Watchdog salvages a transmitter and calls the X-Men in.
stages.whoA: The X-Man he shoots down
stages.whoB: Solarr's guard who later calls for help

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In Jubilee's fairy tale, the wizard Xavier appears to the warrior Jubilee after she wins a piece of the MacTaggert Crystal. He tells her she is the key to its power once the two halves are joined.
stages.whoA: The warrior he tells of the crystal
stages.whoB: The wizard who guides her quest

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Yoshida welcomes Logan to the village since Master Oku has. He wants the village to keep paying tribute, but Logan backs the villagers who fight and beats the Silver Samurai.
stages.whoA: Logan, the outsider Oku welcomes
stages.whoB: The village elder

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Silver Samurai's men demand tribute from Yoshida's village and mock him for not controlling his people. When the villagers rise up, Logan beats the Samurai.
stages.whoA: The bandit lord his village pays
stages.whoB: The elder of a village he squeezes

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Zaladane saves Sauron from Ka-Zar and tells him to fetch Storm for her power. Once Garokk wakes, she refuses Sauron's orders and Garokk turns on him.
stages.whoA: The tool she uses to free Garokk
stages.whoB: The priestess who sends him for Storm

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Zaladane has Sauron bring Storm to the Savage Land and helps strip away her self-control. Storm's unleashed power wakes Garokk.
stages.whoA: The weather witch she uses
stages.whoB: The priestess who unleashes her

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Dr. Rao welcomes Secretary McCoy to Worthington Labs on Alcatraz and introduces him to Jimmy, the boy behind the cure. Later she warns that Hank's politics sit at odds with his own nature.
stages.whoA: The Secretary of Mutant Affairs who tours her lab
stages.whoB: The scientist who shows him the cure's source

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Dr. Rao keeps Jimmy at Worthington Labs on Alcatraz until his DNA is mapped, since his genes are the source of the cure. She brings Hank McCoy in to meet him.
stages.whoA: The boy whose genes make the cure
stages.whoB: The scientist who keeps him at the lab

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Trask and Hank sit with the President as Trask reports Mystique's capture at the FDA. Hank later resigns over the cure weapons while Trask leads the hunt for Magneto.
stages.whoA: The Secretary of Mutant Affairs
stages.whoB: A fellow secretary hunting Magneto

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Mystique is caught breaking into the FDA while posing as Secretary Trask. After Magneto abandons her, she tells the government where his camp is, and Trask sends troops in.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who posed as him
stages.whoB: The secretary she impersonated

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman leads Stryker's soldiers at Alkali Lake and reports that the Cerebro machine is finished. When he asks why the children are being held, Stryker brushes him off, then posts him and his men at the Cerebro door.
stages.whoA: The colonel he serves
stages.whoB: His sergeant at Alkali Lake

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman and Yuriko both serve Stryker at Alkali Lake. They stand at his side as his operation runs.
stages.whoA: Stryker's silent enforcer
stages.whoB: Stryker's sergeant

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Lyman and his men guard the door to Cerebro with orders to shoot anyone who comes near. Magneto pulls the pins from their grenades and kills them all.
stages.whoA: The mutant who kills him at Cerebro's door
stages.whoB: The sergeant guarding Cerebro

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Laurio guards Magneto in his plastic prison and taunts him. After Mystique fills Laurio's blood with iron, Magneto pulls it out of his body to break free.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he guards and taunts
stages.whoB: His taunting prison guard

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Mystique, calling herself Grace, picks Laurio up at a bar and drugs him. She injects him with iron so Magneto can use it to escape.
stages.whoA: The woman who drugs him at a bar
stages.whoB: The guard she drugs to free Magneto

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Bobby brings Logan, Rogue and John home and tells his family he is a mutant. Jealous and upset, Ronny calls the police, and Bobby realizes it was him before he leaves with the others.
stages.whoA: His older brother, a mutant
stages.whoB: His younger brother, who calls the police

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Ronny comes home to find Logan in the house, introduced as Professor Logan. His call brings the police, and an officer shoots Logan during the standoff.
stages.whoA: The stranger his call brings the police on
stages.whoB: Bobby's brother, who calls the police

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad and Nyssa duel Blade to test him, then Asad gives his name and offers the Vampire Nation's truce. Asad then fights the Reapers in the Bloodpack under Blade's command.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker he tests and then follows
stages.whoB: Vampire envoy, then Bloodpack ally

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad and Nyssa bring Blade the truce together and duel him side by side. They hunt Reapers in the Bloodpack until Asad falls beside her in the sewers.
stages.whoA: Fellow envoy and Bloodpack warrior
stages.whoB: Fellow envoy, killed in the sewers

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Asad speaks for the Vampire Nation that Damaskinos rules and brings Blade before him. Damaskinos sends the Bloodpack after the Reapers, ready to sacrifice every one of them.
stages.whoA: The overlord he serves
stages.whoB: His envoy to Blade

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa and Priest serve in the Bloodpack together. When a Reaper bites Priest, he begs Chupa to kill him, and Chupa holds him as he turns. Chupa vows to make Whistler pay for losing him.
stages.whoA: His friend, lost to a Reaper bite
stages.whoB: The friend he begs to end it

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa trades insults with Whistler and blames him for leaving his post when Priest dies. In the sewers Chupa beats Whistler, who sets off Reaper pheromones and leaves Chupa to the Reapers.
stages.whoA: The old man he blames for Priest
stages.whoB: Bloodpack thug who attacks him

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa trained to kill Blade and cheers Reinhardt on when Blade dares the Bloodpack to try. Under the truce he takes Blade's orders against the Reapers, but never hides his contempt.
stages.whoA: The quarry he must follow
stages.whoB: Hostile Bloodpack vampire

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Chupa and Reinhardt are the Bloodpack's loudest brawlers. They fight the Reapers at the House of Pain and both try to put Priest down when he turns.
stages.whoA: Fellow Bloodpack brawler
stages.whoB: Fellow Bloodpack brawler

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Lighthammer and Verlaine are lovers in the Bloodpack. He hides a Reaper bite from the House of Pain and turns in the sewers, and Verlaine ends them both in the sunlight.
stages.whoA: His lover, who dies with him
stages.whoB: Her lover, who turns Reaper

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Lighthammer joins Blade's hunt with the Bloodpack and fights the Reapers at the House of Pain. He keeps his bite secret from Blade until it turns him in the sewers.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker leading his hunt
stages.whoB: Bloodpack vampire who hides a bite

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Priest hunts the Reapers in the Bloodpack under Blade. When the bite turns him and nothing else works, Blade lets the sunlight in to end him.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker who ends his suffering
stages.whoB: Bloodpack vampire he puts down

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Priest and Reinhardt serve in the Bloodpack together. When Priest turns, Reinhardt cuts into his skull, but only sunlight can finish him.
stages.whoA: Bloodpack comrade
stages.whoB: Bloodpack comrade lost to a bite

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Verlaine joins Blade's hunt with the Bloodpack. In the sewers she stops her turned lover, Lighthammer, by taking him into the sunlight.
stages.whoA: The Daywalker leading her hunt
stages.whoB: Bloodpack vampire, Lighthammer's lover

stages.title: Blade II
stages.text: Blade catches Rush and makes him get him into the place where Whistler is held, then lets him go. Later in London, Blade waits behind a peep show window and kills him.
stages.whoA: The hunter who spares him, then returns
stages.whoB: Vampire informant he comes back for

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: After Drake wipes out the Nightstalkers' hideout, Caulder introduces himself and drives Blade to a hidden refuge. There he hands over the last Daystar, built into one arrow.
stages.whoA: The hunter he arms with Daystar
stages.whoB: Nightstalker with the last Daystar

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Caulder picks up Abigail and Blade after the raid and shows them Sommerfield's message. He gives them the Daystar arrow that Abigail later fires at Drake.
stages.whoA: Fellow Nightstalker he arms
stages.whoB: Nightstalker who brings the Daystar

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Agent Ray Cumberland has tracked Blade for a long time and takes him in after Whistler dies. He mocks Blade's war on vampires in questioning, then loses him in a transfer.
stages.whoA: The fugitive he has long tracked
stages.whoB: FBI agent who takes him in

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Cumberland expects Chief Vreede to work with him on Blade. Instead Vreede claims jurisdiction and has Blade transferred out of FBI hands.
stages.whoA: The police chief who takes his prisoner
stages.whoB: FBI agent he pushes aside

stages.title: Blade: Trinity
stages.text: Dr. Vance sends Cumberland out to examine Blade alone. Vance then declares Blade psychotic and recommends a transfer, which costs Cumberland his prisoner.
stages.whoA: Psychiatrist who takes Blade from him
stages.whoB: FBI agent he sends out of the room

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Duane and Billy grow up as friends and install car stereos together. The night Billy goes to take one back, Duane sees Connors shoot him. In a dream life Andre builds for Tandy, both are alive at the Johnsons' party.
stages.whoA: His friend, shot by Connors
stages.whoB: His friend who saw him shot

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone, Billy's little brother, finds Duane running a business and asks him for work to get at Connors. After Tyrone steals and returns a bag of drugs, Duane takes him on, and Tyrone later sees him killed.
stages.whoA: Billy's brother, who works for him
stages.whoB: Billy's friend, who hires him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Duane deals drugs under Connors's protection, though he knows Connors shot Billy. When Duane pushes back and a bag goes missing, Connors sets him up to be shot by O'Reilly.
stages.whoA: The corrupt cop who protects him
stages.whoB: The dealer he protects, then sets up

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Greg is Melissa's lawyer boyfriend and works her case against Roxxon over Nathan. Tandy warns her he is married, and Melissa breaks up with him before he is killed.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend and client
stages.whoB: Her lawyer boyfriend

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy mocks Greg as another married man after her mother. She comes to see he cares for Melissa and asks to help his Roxxon research, then takes his files after he is killed.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend's daughter, who helps him
stages.whoB: Her mother's boyfriend

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mina works at Roxxon to carry on her father Ivan's work while he lies catatonic. Tandy and Tyrone reach him by reminding him of Mina, and father and daughter are reunited.
stages.whoA: His daughter
stages.whoB: Her father

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy enters Ivan's mind and finds him reliving the rig explosion, and she helps him reach the core. Awake, he tells her Nathan hid evidence in a safe deposit box.
stages.whoA: Nathan's daughter, who frees his mind
stages.whoB: The scientist whose mind she frees

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone helps Tandy enter Ivan's mind. Inside the looping rig explosion, he convinces Tandy the voice on the phone is not really her father and helps Ivan reach the core.
stages.whoA: The young man who helps free him
stages.whoB: The scientist he helps free

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Ivan and Nathan work the Roxxon rig together, and Nathan calls him just before the explosion. Tandy hears Nathan's voice again inside Ivan's memory of that night.
stages.whoA: His Roxxon partner
stages.whoB: His Roxxon partner

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Fuchs talks over Connors's record with O'Reilly at the precinct, and they start dating over pancakes. She finds him murdered, and later spirits wear his face to taunt her.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, a detective
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, murdered

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Fuchs defends Connors's record at first, then joins O'Reilly's plan to take him down. Connors beats Fuchs to death and frames Tyrone, then later confesses to clear Tyrone.
stages.whoA: The detective who kills him
stages.whoB: The officer he kills

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy meets Mikayla at Lia's support group and loses her temper when Mikayla defends her abusive boyfriend. Feeling guilty, Tandy searches for her and later tries to pull her out of Andre's trance.
stages.whoA: The girl who tries to help her
stages.whoB: A woman from her support group

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Mikayla turns to Lia's support group to get away from her abusive boyfriend. Lia secretly works in Andre's trafficking ring, which preys on women just like her.
stages.whoA: The group leader who preys on her
stages.whoB: A woman from her group

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Andre draws Mikayla, Melissa and many others into his trance club. Tandy and Tyrone defeat him and set them free.
stages.whoA: The man who traps her in a trance
stages.whoB: One of the people he entrances

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tyrone finds a drugged Mikayla in a private ambulance and tries to get her out, but the men inside open fire. Later he and Tandy free her and the others from Andre's club.
stages.whoA: The young man who tries to rescue her
stages.whoB: A drugged woman he tries to rescue

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Nathan picks Tandy up from ballet the night the rig explodes and drowns in the crash. She tracks down his evidence against Roxxon, learns he abused her mother, and finally faces a vision of him.
stages.whoA: His daughter
stages.whoB: Her father

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Nathan is Melissa's husband until he dies in the rig explosion. Tandy sees in Melissa's memories that he was abusive toward her, and Tandy relives those memories again later.
stages.whoA: His wife
stages.whoB: Her late husband

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Tandy robs Rick, and at a party he corners and attacks her. She stabs him with her first dagger of light and flees.
stages.whoA: The girl who stabs him
stages.whoB: The man who attacks her

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: O'Reilly questions Rick in the hospital, and he says he saw nothing. Spotting his scratches and unbuckled pants, she works out he was the attacker.
stages.whoA: The detective who sees through him
stages.whoB: The man she sees through

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Big Chief Roland welcomes Otis back to the Wild Red Hawks as his old Spy Boy. The Red Hawks gather at Otis's home on the anniversary of Billy's death, and Roland stands by the family when the police come.
stages.whoA: His old Spy Boy
stages.whoB: His Big Chief

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Roland meets Tyrone when Otis brings him to the Red Hawks, where Tyrone takes on Billy's unfinished suit. When the police come for Tyrone, Roland stalls them at the door.
stages.whoA: Otis's son, whom he shields
stages.whoB: The Big Chief who shields him

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Billy is Tyrone's big brother, killed by Connors in front of him. Tyrone finishes Billy's suit and poses as his ghost to get Connors to confess.
stages.whoA: His little brother
stages.whoB: His older brother

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Adina is Billy's mother and still grieves his death. Years later she holds Connors captive and makes him tell her where Billy's body lies.
stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her older son

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Otis is Billy's father. He takes Tyrone to the Red Hawks, where Billy's unfinished suit waits, and hosts them on the anniversary of Billy's death.
stages.whoA: His father
stages.whoB: His older son

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Connors shoots Billy and hides his body. Tyrone haunts him as Billy's ghost until he confesses, and later he tells Adina where the body is.
stages.whoA: The cop who killed him
stages.whoB: The boy he shot

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Matt takes Dante's murder case after hearing his heartbeat and believing he is innocent. He makes the opening statement and tracks the lie back to Officer McKenzie, and Dante is cleared and thanks him.
stages.whoA: His defense attorney, who believes him
stages.whoB: A client he proves innocent

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Foggy doubts Dante at first, calling him a three-time loser. With Matt missing, Foggy questions Dante on the stand alone and struggles through Matt's Braille notes before the case is won.
stages.whoA: His other lawyer, who doubts him at first
stages.whoB: A client he defends alone in court

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Karen works for Foggy and Matt at their small firm. Staying late with Foggy on the Tazzio case, she asks the date of the murder and helps him see that Matt's note points to Wesley Owen Welch.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Nelson & Murdock
stages.whoB: The firm's secretary

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Karen works for Matt at Nelson & Murdock and keeps the office going. When Matt goes missing during the Dante Jackson trial, she tells Foggy not to worry.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Nelson & Murdock
stages.whoB: The firm's secretary

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Jack works as muscle for Fallon, then tries to box clean. Fallon tells him his wins were bought and orders him to take a fall, and when Jack wins anyway Fallon has him killed.
stages.whoA: His fighter and hired muscle
stages.whoB: The mob boss who has him killed

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Before he becomes the Kingpin, Fisk works for Fallon. He kills Jack Murdock when Jack refuses to throw his fight, and later tells Matt it was just business.
stages.whoA: His killer for hire
stages.whoB: The mob boss he once worked for

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Hirsch defends Quesada at his rape trial, objecting to Matt's questions and attacking Angela Sutton's past. Quesada walks free, and Foggy guesses the Kingpin paid the bill.
stages.whoA: His client, whom he gets acquitted
stages.whoB: His defense attorney

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Hirsch faces Matt in court in the Quesada trial. He objects to Matt's line on perjury and wins the acquittal that Matt calls another rapist back on the streets.
stages.whoA: Angela Sutton's lawyer, whom he beats in court
stages.whoB: Quesada's attorney, who beats him in court

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Kirby sells Urich tips about anything weird. For cash he shows Urich that Daredevil's baton unfolds into a blind man's cane, a clue that points Urich toward Matt.
stages.whoA: The reporter who pays him for tips
stages.whoB: A paid source with access to evidence

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Elektra is hired to kill DeMarco. She cuts down his guards and the Hand's men, lets him run, then reaches him past his last guards and kills him with a thrown sai.
stages.whoA: The assassin who hunts him down
stages.whoB: A target she kills

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Meizumi serves Master Roshi on the Hand's council and asks for the task of taking the Treasure. When his men fail, Roshi gives the task to Kirigi instead.
stages.whoA: His master, head of the Hand
stages.whoB: His officer who fails to take the Treasure

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Kirigi tells the council that Meizumi's careful methods have failed and that his men are dead. Meizumi calls Kirigi's forces an abomination, but Kirigi wins the task.
stages.whoA: A rival who takes his task
stages.whoB: A council rival whose men failed

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Kirigi is Roshi's son and calls him Father. Roshi gives him the hunt for the Treasure and promises to step aside as head of the council if he succeeds.
stages.whoA: His son and best assassin
stages.whoB: His father, master of the Hand

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Joe and Mike are the Toro brothers, Cubans who run gambling on the Gulf Coast and launder their cash through Howard Saint. They come to Saint's house together when Castle destroys a shipment of their money.
stages.whoA: His brother and partner
stages.whoB: His brother and partner

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Howard Saint washes the Toro brothers' dirty money. Joe and Mike come to his house after Castle destroys their cash, and when a second shipment is burned, Howard refuses to cover the losses.
stages.whoA: The mobster who launders his family's cash
stages.whoB: One of the Toro brothers, his Cuban partners

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Howard Saint washes the Toro brothers' dirty money through his banks. When Castle torches a shipment, Mike warns Howard he could lose everything, and Howard answers that he has more guns.
stages.whoA: The mobster who launders his cash
stages.whoB: His Cuban partner, who warns him over the lost cash

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Frank points out Candelaria at the reunion as the man locals call a witch doctor. After the massacre Candelaria finds Frank dying, takes care of him, and sends him off with 'Vaya con Dios'. Frank answers that God is going to sit this one out.
stages.whoA: The man he nursed back to health
stages.whoB: The local who saved his life

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Maria is Frank's wife, who has followed him through years of moves for his FBI work. At the reunion she tells him they are not lucky but blessed. Saint's men kill her and their son Will, and her memory drives Frank's war on the Saints.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife, murdered by Saint's men

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Maria and her son Will join Frank's parents and relatives at the first family reunion in five years. Saint's men kill them all and leave Frank for dead.
stages.whoA: Her family, killed with her in Puerto Rico
stages.whoB: Frank's wife

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: John Saint leads the attack on the Castle reunion. Maria flees with Will, but John runs them both down on the pier.
stages.whoA: The man who kills her and her son
stages.whoB: Frank's wife, whom he kills

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Sergei sees a scarred man with a Turkish accent among the men who take Dmitri. Calypso gets him the name Omer Ozdemir, and Kraven tracks him to his family's monastery in Turkey, where Ömer names Rhino and the ambush closes in.
stages.whoA: The hunter who tracks him to Turkey
stages.whoB: The mercenary who abducted Dmitri

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Ömer is among the four men who break into Dmitri's London apartment and carry him off for Rhino.
stages.whoA: Dmitri, the man he kidnaps
stages.whoB: One of his kidnappers

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Rhino is the man behind Dmitri's kidnapping, carried out by Ömer and his men. When Kraven corners him at the monastery, Ömer names Rhino and says Rhino has killed them both.
stages.whoA: The man behind the kidnapping
stages.whoB: The mercenary who took Dmitri for him

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud and Rodriguez are FBI partners on the drained bodies case. They question Martine and Michael together, arrest Michael, and find on CCTV that the killer is someone else.
stages.whoA: His FBI partner
stages.whoB: His FBI partner

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud thanks Michael for the artificial blood that saved his arm in Afghanistan, then presses him about experiments on a boat. After a nurse is found drained, he arrests Michael, who later escapes.
stages.whoA: The doctor he suspects and arrests
stages.whoB: The FBI agent hunting him

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud questions Martine in the hospital as the only survivor of the ship. After Michael escapes, he orders her watched, but she slips away.
stages.whoA: The ship's survivor he questions
stages.whoB: The FBI agent investigating the ship

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Rodriguez helps question Michael and takes him into custody after a nurse is found drained. In the interrogation he presses Michael over Nurse Sutton, a single mother.
stages.whoA: The doctor he helps arrest
stages.whoB: Stroud's partner, who arrests him

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Rodriguez and Stroud question Martine in the hospital about the fang marks on the bodies from the ship.
stages.whoA: The ship's survivor he questions
stages.whoB: An FBI agent investigating the ship

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Kristen works with Michael every day for seven years at Horizon Labs and helps him care for Anna. When she is found drained, Michael fears he killed her and is arrested, then learns Milo did it.
stages.whoA: The doctor she works with
stages.whoB: His nurse of seven years

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Kristen and Martine work together at Horizon Labs and treat Anna when her fever spikes.
stages.whoA: A doctor she works with
stages.whoB: A nurse at Horizon Labs

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Milo secretly takes the cure and kills Kristen in the hospital at night. Michael is blamed until he realizes Milo is the killer.
stages.whoA: Her killer
stages.whoB: The nurse he kills

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Baron Von Rantenraven attacks New York with biplanes from Sky Harbor, and the Mayor calls in Spider-Man. Spider-Man tricks the pilots with a mirror and crashes the Baron's plane into a zeppelin holding up the fortress.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who brings down Sky Harbor
stages.whoB: The baron whose flying fortress he brings down

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Ben is Peter's uncle. Peter, newly given spider powers, lets a thief escape a TV station, and that thief later murders Ben. Peter catches him and vows to use his powers responsibly.
stages.whoA: His nephew, who let his killer escape
stages.whoB: His uncle, murdered by a thief Peter let go

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Ben is May's husband and Peter's uncle. He is murdered by a thief that Peter failed to stop.
stages.whoA: His wife, Peter's Aunt May
stages.whoB: Her husband, murdered by a thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man finds that Blackwell is behind the strange events at his old theatre, then helps him make Jameson spare it. Later the Green Goblin raids Blackwell's house, and the two beat him together.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who helps save his theatre
stages.whoB: The magician who helps him beat the Goblin

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Green Goblin plots to steal Blackwell's magic secrets and uses tricks to rob the city. He chains Spider-Man at Blackwell's house, but Blackwell helps Spider-Man defeat him.
stages.whoA: The Goblin, who steals his magic secrets
stages.whoB: The magician whose secrets he steals

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson backs tearing down Blackwell's old theatre. Blackwell and the theatre's performers, helped by Spider-Man, trick Jameson into changing his mind.
stages.whoA: The publisher who wants his theatre torn down
stages.whoB: The magician who tricks him into sparing the theatre

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man interrupts Boomer's bank blast and chases him, but loses him when a Martian warrior lands. Boomer frees the Martian to rob gold, and Spider-Man captures him once the Martian is gone.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who catches him after a gold heist
stages.whoB: The safecracker he catches after a gold heist

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Brutus is Charles Cameo's bodyguard and helps him steal art. He knocks out the officer delivering a tapestry and takes his place while Cameo poses as Spider-Man. Both are caught.
stages.whoA: His boss, a master of disguise
stages.whoB: His bodyguard and partner in theft

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Brutus knocks Spider-Man down while guarding Charles Cameo. When the police set a trap with a tapestry, Spider-Man catches Brutus along with Cameo.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who catches him with Cameo
stages.whoB: Cameo's bodyguard, who knocks him down

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter meets Carol at a club and they set a date. As Spider-Man he stumbles on her robbery, sees her spider powers, learns she is an alien, and stops a proton test that would destroy her people before they go home.
stages.whoA: Peter, the boy she makes a date with on Earth
stages.whoB: The alien girl he helps get home

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Clive sets the monster Blotto on the city with his Spirit-Scope. Spider-Man finds him, takes the Scope after a fight and uses it to turn Blotto back into film.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who takes his Spirit-Scope
stages.whoB: The man who unleashes Blotto

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Fiddler attacks Flintridge's band with sonic waves and demands a ransom of $1,000,000, then $5,000,000. After Spider-Man beats him, Flintridge recognizes him as Otto.
stages.whoA: The violinist who tries to extort him, Otto
stages.whoB: The rich man he tries to extort

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man protects Flintridge's band from the Fiddler's sonic attacks. He defeats the Fiddler before the second ransom is paid.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who stops the Fiddler
stages.whoB: The man the Fiddler tries to extort

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man leads the crash survivors to the Cloud City of Gold, where DeVargas sends a golden eagle after him and captures the others. DeVargas fires a cannon at him in the volcano, but Spider-Man frees everyone.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who frees his captives
stages.whoB: The conquistador who rules the Cloud City

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Desperado robs banks from his flying robot horse with hypnotic guns. Spider-Man sets a trap using Jameson, gets him off his horse and webs him up.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him up
stages.whoB: The cowboy thief on a flying horse

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man uses Jameson to set a trap for Desperado. The trap works and Desperado ends up webbed.
stages.whoA: The publisher used as bait in his capture
stages.whoB: The cowboy thief he is used to trap

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man tracks Doctor Cool to his hideout, but Cool knocks him out and locks him in a deep freeze with the diamonds. Spider-Man wakes and later buries Cool and his henchman under ice.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who buries him in ice
stages.whoB: The smuggler who freezes him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: A slave on Dr. Manta's island sends a distress call that Spider-Man picks up. He fights the robot beetles and the Mountain Monster, then beats Manta and frees the people.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who frees his slaves
stages.whoB: The slaver of the island castle

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man tries to rescue Doctor Smartyr from ice creatures, until Smartyr stops him: the Plutonians only want help home. Later Doctor Octopus steals his Nullifier, and Spider-Man tracks him down.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who comes to his rescue
stages.whoB: The scientist he tries to rescue

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Doctor Octopus steals Doctor Smartyr's new weapon, the Nullifier. Spider-Man tracks him with a spider-tracer and holds him for the police.
stages.whoA: The villain who steals his Nullifier
stages.whoB: The scientist whose Nullifier he steals

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Doctor Vespasian turns invisible to destroy Spider-Man and impress the city's criminals. Spider-Man beats his invisible dog, then exposes Vespasian at a bank with ice cream.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who exposes him with ice cream
stages.whoB: The invisible scientist out to destroy him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man loses Doctor Von Schlick in a fire, then finds him stealing oil from a tanker. He tracks him to his sewer base and beats him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who tracks him to the sewers
stages.whoB: The slippery oil thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Zapp kidnaps Dr. Caldwell, and Spider-Man helps Skyboy find his lab on Lightning Mountain. Zapp captures Spider-Man, who blinds him with his camera flash and escapes as the lab explodes.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who stops his kidnapping
stages.whoB: Dr. Zapp, a mad scientist he beats

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Zapp kidnaps Jan's father and knocks Jan down with his lightning antenna. Jan, as Skyboy, and Spider-Man rescue Dr. Caldwell from him.
stages.whoA: Skyboy, the son out to rescue his father
stages.whoB: Dr. Zapp, who kidnaps his father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Zapp kidnaps Dr. Caldwell in front of a crowd at his awards ceremony. Caldwell is held in Zapp's lab until Spider-Man and Skyboy free him.
stages.whoA: Dr. Caldwell, the scientist he kidnaps
stages.whoB: Dr. Zapp, his kidnapper

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jan watches his father, Dr. Caldwell, get kidnapped at an awards ceremony. Using his father's Astro-Helmet, Jan becomes Skyboy and helps Spider-Man rescue him.
stages.whoA: Jan, his son, who becomes Skyboy
stages.whoB: Dr. Caldwell, his father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man joins Skyboy to rescue Dr. Caldwell from Dr. Zapp's lab. He beats Zapp and gets Caldwell and Jan out before the lab explodes.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who rescues him
stages.whoB: Dr. Caldwell, the scientist he rescues

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino brings his wax Blackbeard to life to steal a treasure chest. Spider-Man later smashes Parafino's controls at the wax museum.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who made and controls him
stages.whoB: Blackbeard, one of his living wax figures

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The wax Blackbeard knocks Spider-Man overboard and gets away with a treasure chest. Spider-Man tracks the wax figures to Parafino's museum and destroys them.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fails to stop the theft
stages.whoB: Blackbeard, a living wax pirate

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino sends his wax Executioner after Spider-Man. When it is webbed up and found to be wax, the trail leads Spider-Man back to Parafino.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who made and controls him
stages.whoB: The Executioner, one of his living wax figures

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Executioner of Paris attacks Spider-Man, who webs it up. Seeing that it is made of wax, Spider-Man heads for the wax museum.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him up
stages.whoB: The Executioner, a wax attacker

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino sends his wax Jesse James to rob a bank. Spider-Man stops it and later beats Parafino at the museum.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who made and controls him
stages.whoB: Jesse James, one of his living wax figures

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man stops the wax Jesse James from robbing a bank. A guard sees Spider-Man there and takes him for the robber.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who foils his bank robbery
stages.whoB: Jesse James, a wax bank robber

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson pays Dr. Stillwell to create the Scorpion to catch Spider-Man. The Scorpion turns on Jameson instead.
stages.whoA: Jameson, who hires him to make the Scorpion
stages.whoB: Dr. Stillwell, the scientist he hires

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Dr. Stillwell turns a man into the Scorpion for Jameson. After escaping prison, the Scorpion drinks a chemical in Stillwell's lab and trashes it.
stages.whoA: The Scorpion, the man he creates
stages.whoB: Dr. Stillwell, who creates him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Clivendon sends Jameson a one-eyed idol that hypnotizes him into stealing his own money. Spider-Man catches Clivendon and his thief.
stages.whoA: Jameson, whom he robs through a hypnotic idol
stages.whoB: Harley Clivendon, who hypnotizes and robs him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Clivendon knocks Spider-Man out with a boomerang and tries to kill him with an elevator, but is captured. In Florida he knocks him out again, but Spider-Man beats him once more.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats him twice
stages.whoB: Harley Clivendon, a hunter he fights

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Clivendon goes after the missing Dr. Connors in Florida, where Connors has found the Fountain of Youth. Spider-Man finds Connors held in a Spanish fort and beats Clivendon.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, the scientist he hunts
stages.whoB: Harley Clivendon, who hunts him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jackie and Peter set loose a seed from a missing scientist's house, and it grows into a giant plant. Peter travels back in time as Spider-Man to find a way to stop it.
stages.whoA: Peter, a friend
stages.whoB: Jackie, a friend

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Plotter guides Cowboy and Ox as they grab a series of missile blueprints. Spider-Man lures them with a photo of a missing blueprint and catches the whole gang.
stages.whoA: The Plotter, who hires him
stages.whoB: Cowboy, one of his thugs

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Cowboy and Ox knock Spider-Man out and take back the blueprints. Spider-Man uses a photo of himself with the last blueprint to lure them in and capture them.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who captures him
stages.whoB: Cowboy, a blueprint thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter changes into Spider-Man when the revived Kotep attacks a professor. Kotep traps him in his castle with a demon army, but Spider-Man destroys his scepter.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who breaks his scepter
stages.whoB: Kotep, an ancient sorcerer he defeats

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Marie, the Phantom's robot henchwoman, poses as a shop window dummy to set Spider-Man up. Spider-Man beats the Phantom and his robot henchwomen at his base.
stages.whoA: The Phantom, her master
stages.whoB: Marie, his robot henchwoman

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Disguised as a shop window dummy, Marie helps the Phantom set Spider-Man up. Spider-Man finally defeats her and the other robots at the Phantom's base.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats her
stages.whoB: Marie, the Phantom's robot

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man follows a sunken bank to the Molemen's city and seizes their leader. He unmasks him as Mugs Reilly, and the Molemen turn on him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who unmasks him
stages.whoB: Mugs Reilly, the fake Moleman leader

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter resists Pardo's hypnosis at the premiere and stops his goons as Spider-Man. He chases Pardo's giant cat form to the Brooklyn Bridge, where it is electrocuted.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fights him to the end
stages.whoB: Pardo, a hypnotist who becomes a giant cat

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson sends Peter and Penny to the South Pole, and their plane crash lands in a blizzard. Natives seize Penny for a volcano sacrifice, and Spider-Man saves her before the two fly home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves her from the natives
stages.whoB: Penny, the Bugle's pilot

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Jameson sends Penny to fly Peter to the South Pole for pictures of a crashed nose cone. She brings Peter home safely after the trip.
stages.whoA: Jameson, who sends her south
stages.whoB: Penny, the Bugle's pilot

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Plotter guides Ox and Cowboy as they grab a series of blueprints. Spider-Man lures them with a photo of the blueprint they left behind and catches the whole gang.
stages.whoA: The Plotter, who hires him
stages.whoB: Ox, one of his thugs

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Ox and Cowboy knock Spider-Man out and take back the blueprints. Spider-Man uses a photo of himself with the last blueprint to lure them in and capture them.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who captures him
stages.whoB: Ox, a blueprint thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino catches the escaped con Red Dog Melvin and disguises him as a waxwork to lure Spider-Man. Melvin revives and attacks Parafino, and Spider-Man webs them both up.
stages.whoA: Parafino, who uses him as bait
stages.whoB: Red Dog Melvin, his bait

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Parafino uses Red Dog Melvin, disguised as a waxwork, as bait for Spider-Man. When Melvin revives and attacks Parafino, Spider-Man webs them both up.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who webs him up
stages.whoB: Red Dog Melvin, an escaped con

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Scarf's gang robs the rich with illusions and hits a museum with laughing gas. Spider-Man alerts the police, who catch the gang as he defeats the Scarf.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who defeats him
stages.whoB: The Scarf, an illusionist thief

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Peter and Señor Fuentiz crash in the Andes, and Spider-Man leads the survivors past natives and bats. DeVargas captures Fuentiz, and Spider-Man frees him before the volcano erupts.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who leads him to safety
stages.whoB: Señor Fuentiz, his professor

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Shakespeare frees a gorilla at the zoo, and Spider-Man recaptures it. At the college museum Shakespeare hits Spider-Man with liquid latex, but Spider-Man beats him and his men.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who defeats him
stages.whoB: Shakespeare, a museum robber

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Sir Galahad stops a robbery and then keeps the money, while Jameson blames Spider-Man. Spider-Man beats him in a joust over King Arthur's sword and knocks him into the waterfront.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats him in a joust
stages.whoB: Sir Galahad, a crooked knight

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Skymaster's men kidnap Roy Robinson and take him to an airship hidden in a cloud. Spider-Man finds it, beats Skymaster and his goons, and the ship crashes into the harbor.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who wrecks his airship
stages.whoB: Skymaster, a kidnapper in the clouds

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Swami fools the city with illusions and traps Spider-Man in his crystal ball. Spider-Man escapes, finds the dry ice behind the snowstorm and has the Swami arrested.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who exposes him
stages.whoB: The Swami, a fake mystic

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: Spider-Man knocks Vulcan out and webs him up, but Boomer frees him. Vulcan robs the Bank of Nations, and Spider-Man turns his homing thunderbolt back on him and sends him into space.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who sends him into space
stages.whoB: Vulcan, a Martian warrior

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Hobie runs petty robberies for the crime boss Iceberg and skims some of the loot. Iceberg has his men try to kill him, and Hobie later returns as the Prowler and defeats him.
stages.whoA: Iceberg, the crime boss who wants him dead
stages.whoB: Hobie Brown, the crook who skims his loot

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In prison Hobie saves Richard Fisk, so the Kingpin gets him released and gives him a stealth battle suit. The suit then shocks him and the Kingpin says he controls him, until Hobie and Spider-Man find a way to disarm it.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, who traps him in a rigged suit
stages.whoB: The Prowler, a crook he tries to control

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Hobie saves Richard Fisk from another prisoner's attack in prison. Richard tells his father, who repays Hobie by clearing his name.
stages.whoA: Richard Fisk, whose life he saves in prison
stages.whoB: Hobie Brown, who saves his life in prison

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie gets Illyena's address from his friend Boris Pushkin and brings Peter to her. She shows them the evidence her father kept on the Doomsday device.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, a Daily Bugle editor
stages.whoB: Illyena Groitzig, Groitzig's daughter

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Chameleon poses as Illyena's husband Karl. He takes the evidence she shows Peter and Robbie and leads Spider-Man into a trap.
stages.whoA: The Chameleon, posing as her husband
stages.whoB: Illyena Groitzig, whose husband he poses as

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thunderer fights beside Captain America in the Six American Warriors during World War II. When Cap returns from the vortex fifty years later, they fight the Red Skull together again, and Cap is trapped once more.
stages.whoA: Captain America, his old team leader
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thunderer and Keene Marlow, the Destroyer, serve together in the Six American Warriors. Fifty years later they reunite to fight the Kingpin's Insidious Six and the Red Skull.
stages.whoA: The Destroyer, his old teammate
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, his old teammate

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Thunderer and the Six try to stop the Red Skull's doomsday plot in World War II. When the Skull is freed fifty years later, the Thunderer fights him again.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, the Six's old enemy
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Red Skull's doomsday device turns his son Kragov into Electro. The Thunderer and the Six fight him with Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Electro, the Red Skull's son
stages.whoB: The Thunderer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: John is J. Jonah Jameson's son, and his crash leads Jonah to put a bounty on Spider-Man. When Jonah visits him in hospital, John tells him the Rhino was at the scene, and Jonah calls the bounty off.
stages.whoA: His father, J. Jonah Jameson
stages.whoB: His son John, an astronaut

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Alistair Smythe sends the Shocker to kidnap John from his hospital bed. The Shocker holds him for ransom for the Promethium X until Spider-Man frees him.
stages.whoA: The Shocker, who kidnaps him
stages.whoB: John Jameson, his ransom hostage

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After John's shuttle crashes on the George Washington Bridge, the Kingpin sends the Rhino to steal the Promethium X. John later tells his father the Rhino was there.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, who robs his shuttle
stages.whoB: John Jameson, the astronaut whose shuttle he robs

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wilson Fisk gives Dr. Ohnn a lab to continue his portal research, and Ohnn hides his new powers from him. The Kingpin takes Silvia hostage to force the Spot to capture Spider-Man, but Ohnn double-crosses him, and Fisk then lends him a plane to close the rift.
stages.whoA: Wilson Fisk, who funds and then threatens him
stages.whoB: Dr. Ohnn, the scientist he funds

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Tony Stark shuts down Dr. Ohnn's portal project after the trouble with Carnage and Dormammu and fires him. Ohnn is bitter and takes Fisk's offer.
stages.whoA: Tony Stark, who fires him
stages.whoB: Dr. Ohnn, the scientist he fires

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jameson goes back to his old contact Joey Nails for information to clear Robbie. Joey has him restrained in a chair, but Jameson gets free, locks Joey in it instead and takes what he needs.
stages.whoA: Jigsaw Jameson, an old contact who outwits him
stages.whoB: Joey Nails, a shady old contact

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene Marlow, an old friend of Ben's, visits May at the Parker home. Peter overhears them talking about what May must tell him about his parents.
stages.whoA: May Parker, his late friend Ben's wife
stages.whoB: Keene Marlow, Ben's old friend

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene and Ben grow up as friends who dream of being heroes. After Keene's wife Lenora dies, he gives Ben his costume and ring to keep.
stages.whoA: Ben Parker, his childhood friend
stages.whoB: Keene Marlow, his childhood friend

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene Marlow serves S.H.I.E.L.D. as a commander under Nick Fury. Both are drawn into the hunt for the doomsday weapon.
stages.whoA: Nick Fury, his S.H.I.E.L.D. chief
stages.whoB: Commander Keene Marlow, a S.H.I.E.L.D. officer

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Keene fights beside Captain America as the Destroyer in the Six American Warriors during World War II. When Cap returns from the vortex, they fight the Red Skull together again.
stages.whoA: Captain America, his old team leader
stages.whoB: The Destroyer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Destroyer and the Six try to stop the Red Skull's doomsday plot in World War II. When the Skull is freed fifty years later, the Destroyer fights him again.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, the Six's old enemy
stages.whoB: The Destroyer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mary and Richard come to warn Illyena's father that they have been found out. Mary comforts the young Illyena, who has been listening, and is reminded of her own son.
stages.whoA: Illyena, Groitzig's young daughter
stages.whoB: Mary Parker, the spy who comforts her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Quentin Beck finds the scarred Miranda under Wonder Studios and keeps her alive as a cyborg. He admits the body swap could never work and that he loves her as she is, and he stays with her as the complex explodes.
stages.whoA: Quentin Beck, who loves her
stages.whoB: Miranda Wilson, the star he loves

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mary Jane gets Miranda's old leading role, and Miranda captures her to swap their bodies. When the swap fails, Miranda lets her go.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, the look-alike she captures
stages.whoB: Miranda Wilson, who tries to steal her body

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man comes into the tunnels under Wonder Studios to rescue Mary Jane from Miranda's machine. He gets Mary Jane out as the complex explodes.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves Mary Jane from her
stages.whoB: Miranda Wilson, a cyborg who captures Mary Jane

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Monitor and the other lizards kidnap Curt Connors, calling him their father. Connors becomes the Lizard and leads them, until Margaret, Debra and Mary Jane change him and the lizards back.
stages.whoA: Curt Connors, the 'father' he kidnaps
stages.whoB: Monitor, a lizard made from his DNA

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Monitor and the lizards kidnap Mary Jane along with Connors. She escapes and helps change Connors and the lizards back.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, who he kidnaps
stages.whoB: Monitor, a lizard who kidnaps her

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Peter signs up for Bonesaw McGraw's cage match to win $3000 and is announced as the Amazing Spider-Man. Bonesaw mocks and pounds him, but Peter pins him in two minutes.
stages.whoA: The masked newcomer who pins him in a cage match
stages.whoB: Bonesaw McGraw, the wrestler he beats for prize money

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Flash laughs at Peter from the school bus and, after a tray of food hits him, starts a hallway fight. Peter, newly powered, dodges his punches and sends him flying across the hall.
stages.whoA: Peter, the classmate who knocks him down
stages.whoB: Flash, the school bully he beats in a fight

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Flash is Mary Jane's boyfriend and takes her for a ride in his new car. After graduation she hands back his ring and leaves him.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, his girlfriend until graduation
stages.whoB: Flash, the boyfriend she leaves at graduation

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Mr. Balkan sits on the Oscorp board that reviews Norman's work. When the board sells the company, he tells Norman he is out, and the Green Goblin kills him at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Norman, the founder he forces out, and his killer
stages.whoB: Mr. Balkan, a board member who ousts him

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Mr. Balkan and Max Fargas visit Oscorp together as board members and vote to sell the company. Both die when the Green Goblin attacks the board at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Max Fargas, a fellow board member
stages.whoB: Mr. Balkan, a fellow board member

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Max Fargas tells Norman the board is unanimous on selling Oscorp and forcing him out. Days later the Green Goblin kills him at the Unity Day festival.
stages.whoA: Norman, the founder he ousts, and his killer
stages.whoB: Max Fargas, the board member who ousts him

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: At the Unity Day festival Harry asks Max Fargas if he has seen his father. Moments later the Green Goblin attacks the board.
stages.whoA: Harry, Norman's son, who greets him at the festival
stages.whoB: Mr. Fargas, an Oscorp board member

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Dr. Stromm runs Norman's performance enhancer work at Oscorp and warns it must go back to formula. Under pressure he helps Norman test it on himself, and the crazed Norman kills him.
stages.whoA: Norman, his boss, who kills him
stages.whoB: Dr. Stromm, his lead scientist, whom he kills

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: General Slocum visits Oscorp and threatens to give Norman's military contract to Quest Aerospace. When Quest tests its exoskeleton, a glider rider bombs the test and kills him.
stages.whoA: Norman, the contractor he threatens, and his killer
stages.whoB: General Slocum, who threatens his contract

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Henry Jackson, the boy across the street, helps May pack for her move for $5. May tells Peter that Henry wants to be Spider-Man and that kids like him need a hero.
stages.whoA: Mrs. Parker, the neighbor he helps move
stages.whoB: Henry Jackson, the boy who helps her pack

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Henry greets Peter at May's house and asks where Spider-Man has gone. Peter says he quit, and May's speech about Henry needing a hero moves him.
stages.whoA: Peter, May's nephew who takes Spider-Man's pictures
stages.whoB: Henry Jackson, May's young neighbor

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Mr. Aziz scolds Peter for always being late and gives him one last chance to deliver eight pizzas in minutes. When Peter arrives late, Aziz fires him.
stages.whoA: Peter, his unreliable delivery boy
stages.whoB: Mr. Aziz, his boss at Joe's Pizza

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The High Evolutionary has Dr. Borowski separate Venom and Carnage from their hosts. Borowski takes the Venom symbiote to his lab to study it, but Spider-Man steals it back, and the High Evolutionary is furious at his failure.
stages.whoA: His master, who wants the symbiote studied
stages.whoB: A lizard scientist who loses the Venom symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Dr. Borowski's crew lures Venom into an alley and splits Eddie Brock from the symbiote with sonic waves. Eddie is left dying while Borowski studies the symbiote in his lab.
stages.whoA: Venom's host, whom he splits from the symbiote
stages.whoB: The scientist who takes his symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man sneaks into Dr. Borowski's lab and takes the Venom symbiote out of his DNA machine. He brings it back to the dying Eddie Brock, ruining Borowski's work.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who steals the symbiote from his lab
stages.whoB: A lizard scientist studying the Venom symbiote

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Daniel learns his brother Durwood is alive after decades apart and goes to find him with Spider-Man. Durwood betrays them to the High Evolutionary, and in their fight Durwood falls into a purifying tank and drowns.
stages.whoA: His brother, whom he betrays
stages.whoB: His long-lost brother, who betrays him

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man comes with Daniel to free his brother Durwood. Durwood springs a trap on them for the High Evolutionary, hoping for a promotion.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom he lures into a trap
stages.whoB: Daniel's brother, who sells them out

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Durwood works at the High Evolutionary's water plant. The High Evolutionary promises to put him in charge of it if he hands over Spider-Man and Daniel, and Durwood goes along.
stages.whoA: His ruler, who promises him a promotion
stages.whoB: A plant worker who betrays Spider-Man

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Sir Ram secretly creates Firedrake, a dragon Bestial, and puts him in charge of the front that kidnaps humans for his experiments. Firedrake guards the operation until Spider-Man and the Vulture shut it down.
stages.whoA: His creator, who runs the kidnapping plot
stages.whoB: His dragon Bestial and guard

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Spider-Man breaks into Sir Ram's lab to free kidnapped humans and fights Firedrake. He throws a canister of liquid nitrogen into the dragon's mouth and knocks him down.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who knocks him out
stages.whoB: A fire-breathing dragon guarding Sir Ram's lab

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: The Vulture joins Spider-Man to stop Sir Ram's kidnappings. Together they fight Firedrake and shut down his facility.
stages.whoA: A Bestial hero who helps shut him down
stages.whoB: Sir Ram's dragon guard

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Mary Jane is Peter's wife and knows he is Spider-Man. She worries about the danger he faces, and stays on Earth when he heads to Counter-Earth.
stages.whoA: Her husband, Spider-Man
stages.whoB: His wife, waiting on Earth

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Nick Fury confronts Spider-Man over the shuttle he is taking to Counter-Earth. Spider-Man talks him into letting him go to rescue John Jameson, and Fury backs off.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who talks him round
stages.whoB: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s chief, who tries to stop him

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Prima's band of cast-off Bestials seizes Spider-Man and the Goblin in Atlantic City. Spider-Man goes along with them on a raid into a High Evolutionary hideout, where he hopes to find a ship home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, taken by her band
stages.whoB: Leader of the cast-off Bestials

stages.title: Spider-Man Unlimited
stages.text: Prima's band takes the Goblin along with Spider-Man in Atlantic City. The Goblin ends up working with her cast-off Bestials against the High Evolutionary.
stages.whoA: The Goblin, an ally of her band
stages.whoB: Leader of the cast-off Bestials

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jeff and Rio meet C. Weber about Miles's college plans. After Miles runs off, she tells Jeff his son is lying to him and that he knows it.
stages.whoA: Miles's father, whom she warns
stages.whoB: Miles's counselor, who says he is lying

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Rio sits in on C. Weber's college meeting about Miles. She is upset to hear about his B in Spanish and the classes he has missed.
stages.whoA: Miles's mother at the college meeting
stages.whoB: Miles's counselor
